raw.title: Business Development Representative
raw.description:
About Zip

Zip is the AI platform for enterprise procurement — built for humans and agents working together. By orchestrating procurement across teams, tools, and suppliers with the help of AI agents, companies can secure the resources they need to innovate faster than ever before.

The world’s most influential enterprises trust Zip, including T-Mobile, OpenAI, AMD, Mars, Dollar Tree, and more. Together they’ve saved over $8 billion and processed over $500 billion in spend. Zip’s team includes product leaders from Apple, Airbnb, and Meta, as well as former procurement leaders from United Health, Sanofi, MGM Resorts, Discover, and NASA.

Backed by Adams Street, Alkeon, BOND, CRV, DST, Tiger Global, and Y Combinator, Zip has raised $371 million, most recently at a $2.2 billion valuation and has been recognized by Forbes Fintech 50, Fast Company's Most Innovative Companies, Inc. Best in Business, and LinkedIn Top Startups.

Your Role

Zip is looking for a highly motivated, outgoing, and tech-savvy sales representative with strong business acumen to join our growing Business Development team. As a Business Development Representative, you will generate new business by prospecting outbound leads through cold outreach and work collaboratively across our sales organization to set high-value meetings. This is a highly strategic role that requires creativity, resilience, and the ability to partner effectively with an Account Executive to create new business opportunities. This is a fully remote role supporting our EMEA team.

Joining the Business Development team is an opportunity to fast-track your career in sales. Applicants should have a growth mindset and be excited to work collaboratively across the Revenue organization. You will learn consultative selling and hone in on our best-in-class outbound motion to execute our sales strategy. High performers in the BDR role will open up new opportunities for career growth within our rapidly growing organization.

We’re looking for a customer-focused, highly motivated, and driven individual with a desire to grow and advance in a career in sales. If you have a proactive and customer-first mentality with the passion to demonstrate Zip’s commitment to our merchants, we’d love to talk to you!

You Will

  • Partner closely with our VP of Sales and Account Executives to identify and source meetings that lead to pipeline and closed revenue

  • Prospect across a high volume of accounts, with a keen eye on strategically prioritizing your time

  • Become a market expert – researching and understanding our target industries and personas, and what makes them tick

  • Build a point of view on how to help customers with their needs and the right qualifying questions to ask

  • Be adaptable and flexible – as part of an early-stage hyper growth company, we are rapidly growing out our process but we want to you to help shape our sales process

Qualifications

  • 6-12+ months or equivalent sales experience

  • A consistent track record of meeting and exceeding goals

  • Be a highly strategic thinker and problem solver with a solutions first and adaptable mindset

Nice to Haves

  • Experience with Salesforce, Outreach, ZoomInfo, ScratchPad, Gong, and/or SalesNavigator

  • Tech experience or proven success in a fast-paced environment

  • A strong passion for fintech is a plus

  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills with a paramount focus on detail

  • An ability to celebrate change and embrace accountability

Within 2 weeks, you will...

  • Complete Zip’s new hire training & onboarding program alongside other new Zip team members

  • Gain a broader understanding of our products and how your role fits into the organization

  • Partner with the Director of Business Development on key success metrics for your role and how you will measure against them

  • Partner with the Director of Business Development to discuss your personal and professional goals

  • Begin developing familiarity with our business, platform, and applications, as well as our company’s key metrics

  • Acclimate yourself with the day-to-day responsibilities of Zip’s Business Development team by shadowing team members, listening to recorded customer calls, and working closely with our Account Executive team

Within 1 month, you will...

  • Identify and contact prospective clients to build a pipeline through a variety of methods including, but not limited to cold-calling, emailing, social media outreach, and mass email campaigns

  • Create a professional and engaging first impression with our prospects and customers

  • Create, maintain and update our database of prospects with complete information and emails

  • Thoroughly qualify all outbound opportunities and collaborate with Account Executives for a smooth and sophisticated customer experience

  • Generate net new business through outbound prospecting

  • Prioritize leads, research prospects and position relevant product features to solve business needs while strategically managing your time

  • Manage follow-up with calls-to-action to consistently build a sales pipeline

Within 2 months, you will...

Achieve department standards for activity that includes:

  • Making a minimum number of quality outbound calls per day

  • Scheduling a minimum number of new quality discovery calls per week

  • Become a market expert by researching and understanding our target industries and personas

  • Exceed activity and pipeline goals on a monthly basis

  • Consistently reflect on your own skill and development gaps along with the Director of Business Development to identify personal and professional goals

  • Become a mentor to new hires entering into the Business Development organization

  • Become a key stakeholder in Zip’s growth as we continue to scale our core business

Perks & Benefits

At Zip, we’re committed to providing our employees with everything they need to do their best work.

  • 📈 Start-up equity

  • 🦷 Health, vision & dental coverage

  • 🚠 Team building events & happy hours

  • 🌴 Flexible PTO

  • 💻 Apple equipment plus home office budget

We're looking to hire Zipsters and that means hiring people who take ownership, communicate openly, have an underdog mindset, and are excited to increase the pace of innovation for every business in the world. We encourage all candidates to apply even if your experience doesn't exactly match up to our job description. We are committed to building a diverse and inclusive workspace where everyone (regardless of age, religion, ethnicity, gender, sexual orientation, and more) feels like they belong. We look forward to hearing from you!

title: Technical Founder's Associate (Berlin, on-site)
description: sensmore is a Berlin/Potsdam-based robotics startup delivering production-proven automation for industries where the world’s raw materials are extracted, moved, and processed. Its automation system transforms heavy machines into intelligent, automated robots powered by Physical AI and vertically integrates them into the full production environment: from the machine and safety infrastructure to network infrastructure, site processes, and operational interfaces. Co-developed with customers, sensmore is backed by Point Nine Capital, leading industry investors, the State of Brandenburg, and the European Union. Role Overview: We are looking for a hands-on Founder's Associate to work directly with our two founders in Berlin. This role suits someone with a technical background who has already run complex projects to a deadline in a genuinely demanding environment - ideally 1–3 years at a top-tier strategy consultancy in Germany (Bain, McKinsey, BCG or similar), where managing multiple workstreams, stakeholders, and shifting priorities at once was the daily standard. The core of the job is scoping and managing complex projects and keeping internal and external alignment in check, working side by side with both founders. You should be technical enough to earn credibility with our engineering team. Key Responsibilities: Scope and run high-priority projects end to end on behalf of the founders (defining the plan, driving delivery, and reporting on progress) across customer pilots, field deployments, internal tooling, and process automation. Keep internal and external alignment in check: make sure engineering, commercial, and operations are working to the same plan, and that customers, partners, and suppliers know where things stand. Hold several complex workstreams in parallel, with the structure, pace, and stakeholder management expected in a consulting environment, and keep them all moving when priorities change mid-week. Prepare material for investors, grant programmes, and customers, and work closely with both founders on whatever is most critical that week. Required Qualifications: Bachelor's or Master's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or a closely related technical field. 1–3 years of project management experience in a high-demand, delivery-focused environment: top-tier management consulting in the German market strongly preferred. You should be able to point to specific projects you scoped and owned, the stakeholders you managed, and the deadlines you hit. Proven ability to structure ambiguous problems into a plan and deliver against it under time pressure, without a project manager above you. Business-fluent German (native or near-native preferred) and an interest in customers in mining, construction, or heavy industry. Able to ship working software with AI coding tools such as Claude Code or Cursor – scripts, prototypes, and automations – with enough Python and SQL to review, debug, and trust what comes out. Valid category B driving licence, and the willingness to drive to customer sites, transport equipment, and move machines and hardware. Based in Berlin (or willing to relocate), happy to work on-site, and comfortable spending time in a workshop and around heavy machinery in operation. Preferred Skills: Experience managing projects with German industrial, mining, or construction clients. Exposure to robotics, autonomous systems, machine learning, or industrial hardware. A track record of building something yourself outside a structured employer What We Offer: Build physical AI for the world's largest off-highway machinery – making them intelligent, safe, and ready for every tough task Join the pioneer in intelligent robotics backed by Point Nine & other Tier 1 investors Combine cutting-edge robotics research in end-to-end learning & Vision Language Action Model with real-world heavy mobile equipment Tailor your own career path, whether you like to become technical specialist or technical team lead Experience a great team culture, beverages, and an amazing office environment Benefits: Attractive compensation package and stock options. Beverages on-site and regular social events. Engage with top-tier researchers, engineers, and thought leaders. Influence the future of robotic technologies and tackle significant technological challenges. Assistance with relocation to Berlin. About Us: Heavy machinery, light years ahead. sensmore automates the world's largest machines with unprecedented intelligence. Our proprietary Physical AI enables heavy machines such as wheel loaders to instantly adapt to dynamic environments and execute new tasks without prior training. We integrate cutting-edge robotics into a platform powering intelligence and automation products - transforming productivity and safety for customers in mining, construction, and adjacent industries today. We are proudly backed by Point Nine and other Tier 1 investors. Find Jobs in Germany on Arbeitnow

title: CPO - Chief Product Officer (m/w/d)
description: Stellenbeschreibung Pammys ist in wenigen Jahren auf über 1,3 Millionen Kundinnen und Kunden gewachsen. Jetzt bauen wir die Product Organisation für unsere nächste Wachstumsphase: neue Kategorien, höhere Volumen, internationale Märkte und ein global skalierbares Produktionsnetzwerk. Dafür suchen wir einen Chief Product Officer (m/w/d), der unsere gesamte Product Organisation aufbaut, führt und auf das nächste Level bringt. Wir suchen keinen CPO, der Produkt nur aus Strategie-Meetings kennt. Wir suchen einen Builder und Operator, der weiß, wie man Product Development, Engineering, Design, Merchandising, Sourcing, Production, Quality und Product Marketing zu einer leistungsfähigen Organisation verbindet. Du entwickelst gemeinsam mit den Gründern unsere langfristige Produkt- und Kategoriestrategie und verantwortest gleichzeitig, dass diese operativ funktioniert. Wenn ein Development-Prozess nicht funktioniert, gehst du rein. Wenn Qualität, Costing oder Timelines nicht stimmen, willst du verstehen warum und löst das Problem gemeinsam mit deinem Team. Wenn entscheidende Kompetenzen fehlen, baust du sie auf. Ein zentraler Bestandteil deiner Rolle ist der Aufbau unserer internationalen Product- und Sourcing-Struktur in China und perspektivisch weiteren Produktionsmärkten wie Vietnam. Dein Ziel ist klar: Bessere Produkte. Schnellere Entwicklungszyklen. Höhere Qualität. Stärkere Margen. Klare Ownership. Eine Product Organisation, die mit Pammys skalieren kann. Deine Aufgaben Du verantwortest den Aufbau und die Weiterentwicklung zentraler Unternehmensbereiche und entwickelst Strukturen, Verantwortlichkeiten, Prozesse und Führung konsequent weiter. Du baust leistungsfähige Teams und Funktionen entlang der gesamten Wertschöpfungskette auf – von Strategie und Entwicklung über Beschaffung und Produktion bis hin zu Vermarktung und kommerzieller Steuerung. Du rekrutierst, führst und entwickelst starke Führungskräfte und Spezialisten und schaffst eine Organisation, die eigenständig, klar strukturiert und skalierbar arbeitet. Gemeinsam mit den Gründern entwickelst du die langfristige Unternehmens- und Wachstumsstrategie und übersetzt sie in klare Prioritäten, Strukturen und operative Maßnahmen. Du stellst sicher, dass strategische Initiativen von der ersten Idee bis zur erfolgreichen Umsetzung effizient, bereichsübergreifend und ergebnisorientiert gesteuert werden. Du optimierst Prozesse mit dem Ziel, Entscheidungswege zu verkürzen, Komplexität zu reduzieren und die Organisation schneller und leistungsfähiger zu machen. Du entwickelst unser internationales Partner-, Produktions- und Lieferantennetzwerk weiter und führst strategische Verhandlungen zu Kosten, Kapazitäten, Qualität, Zeitplänen und Rahmenbedingungen. Du baust gemeinsam mit uns unsere internationale Präsenz, insbesondere in China, weiter aus und entwickelst dort langfristig ein leistungsfähiges lokales Team. Du etablierst klare Qualitäts-, Steuerungs- und Kontrollmechanismen und stellst sicher, dass vereinbarte Standards im Tagesgeschäft konsequent umgesetzt werden. Du verantwortest gemeinsam mit den relevanten Teams die kommerzielle Steuerung zentraler Geschäftsbereiche – einschließlich Kosten, Preisen, Margen, Mengen, Zeitplänen und Profitabilität. Du schaffst klare Verantwortlichkeiten und stellst sicher, dass wichtige Initiativen über alle beteiligten Funktionen hinweg konsequent vorangetrieben werden. Du verknüpfst Strategie und operative Umsetzung eng mit Kundenbedürfnissen, Marktkenntnissen und kommerziellem Potenzial. Du arbeitest regelmäßig direkt mit unseren internationalen Teams und Partnern zusammen und steigst bei kritischen Themen auch selbst tief in operative Fragestellungen ein. Dein Profil Mehrjährige Führungserfahrung auf Director-, VP-, SVP- oder C-Level im Product-Bereich einer Footwear Brand oder eines vergleichbaren internationalen Consumer-Unternehmens. Nachweisbare Erfahrung im Aufbau und in der Skalierung einer multidisziplinären Product Organisation. Tiefgehendes Know-how in Footwear Development, Engineering, Construction, Materials, Fit, Sampling, Testing und Production. Langjährige direkte Erfahrung mit Footwear-Fabriken und Produktionspartnern in China sowie idealerweise ein belastbares Netzwerk im asiatischen Beschaffungsmarkt. Sehr gute Kenntnisse in Sourcing, Costing, Supplier Management, Production Planning und kommerziellen Verhandlungen. Erfahrung im Aufbau und in der Skalierung von Produktportfolios, Kategorien und internationalen Produktlinien. Starkes kommerzielles Verständnis für Marge, Pricing, Herstellkosten, Volumen, Sortiment und Produktprofitabilität. Du kannst Strategie auf C-Level entwickeln und gleichzeitig operativ tief genug einsteigen, um komplexe Product-, Development- oder Production-Probleme selbst zu verstehen und voranzutreiben. Du bist ein Builder und fühlst dich in einer Organisation wohl, in der Strukturen nicht vollständig vorgegeben sind, sondern von dir geschaffen werden. Du führst mit hohen Standards, klarer Verantwortung und starker Execution. Du triffst Entscheidungen schnell, datenbasiert und mit ausgeprägtem unternehmerischem Verständnis. Sehr gutes Englisch sowie hohe internationale Reisebereitschaft, insbesondere nach China und zu unseren Produktionspartnern. Standortnähe zu Hamburg beziehungsweise die Bereitschaft, regelmäßig vor Ort mit unserem Team zu arbeiten. Deine Vorteile bei Pammys Echte C-Level Ownership: Du verantwortest die gesamte Product Organisation und damit eine der wichtigsten Säulen unserer zukünftigen Unternehmensstrategie. Build instead of manage: Du übernimmst keine fertige Konzernorganisation, sondern kannst Teams, Strukturen, Prozesse und Verantwortlichkeiten aktiv aufbauen. Direkter Einfluss auf unser Wachstum: Du entscheidest maßgeblich mit, welche Produkte und Kategorien Pammys in den kommenden Jahren entwickelt und skaliert. Direkter Zugang zu den Gründern: Produktentscheidungen werden schnell getroffen und du bist unmittelbar an den wichtigsten strategischen Entscheidungen beteiligt. Internationaler Scope: Du baust unsere Strukturen in China mit auf und arbeitest direkt mit Fabriken, Produzenten und internationalen Partnern. Hohe Geschwindigkeit: Keine endlosen Abstimmungsschleifen. Wenn wir überzeugt sind, setzen wir um. Starkes Fundament: Du baust auf einer Footwear Brand mit über 1,3 Millionen Kundinnen und Kunden auf und gestaltest von hier aus die nächste Wachstumsphase. Großer Gestaltungsspielraum: Du kannst eine Product Organisation entwickeln, die auf Geschwindigkeit, Qualität, Profitabilität und internationale Skalierung ausgelegt ist. Executive Package: Ein der Verantwortung, Erfahrung und dem Impact der Rolle entsprechendes Vergütungspaket inklusive leistungsabhängiger Komponenten. Deshalb bauen wir unser Controlling massiv aus und suchen vier (Senior) Controller / Finance Business Partner (m/w/d) , die gemeinsam mit uns die nächste Wachstumsphase steuern. Bei uns geht es nicht darum, Excel-Dateien zu verwalten oder rückblickend Zahlen zusammenzufassen. Du sitzt nah an den Entscheidungen, challengest Annahmen, erkennst Abweichungen frühzeitig und übersetzt Zahlen in konkrete Maßnahmen. Dein Ziel: Wachstum profitabel machen und jederzeit wissen, welche Stellschraube den größten finanziellen Impact hat. Je nach Erfahrung und Schwerpunkt übernimmst du Verantwortung für einen oder mehrere unserer zentralen Unternehmensbereiche wie Marketing & E-Commerce, Product & Sourcing, Operations & Logistics oder Corporate Finance . Deine Aufgaben Du übernimmst im Marketing die Analyse und Weiterentwicklung unserer Kennzahlen und schaffst damit eine fundierte Grundlage für datenbasierte Entscheidungen. Du analysierst relevante Marketing-KPIs und stellst sicher, dass Abweichungen frühzeitig erkannt und konkrete Handlungsempfehlungen abgeleitet werden. Du bewertest die Performance unserer Marketingkanäle und Kampagnen bis auf Zielgruppen-, Produkt- oder Marktebene und identifizierst Optimierungspotenziale. Du analysierst Conversion Rates, Kundenakquisitionskosten, Return on Ad Spend und Customer Lifetime Value und machst Zusammenhänge transparent. Du entwickelst gemeinsam mit Marketing, Finance und Data aussagekräftige Reportings, Dashboards und Frühwarnsysteme . Du verbindest Marketing-Kennzahlen mit wirtschaftlichen Ergebnissen und zeigst auf, welche Maßnahmen zur Kundengewinnung, Kundenbindung und Profitabilität beitragen . Du erstellst Performance-Prognosen und Szenarioanalysen und bewertest die möglichen Auswirkungen unterschiedlicher Marketingmaßnahmen. Du definierst gemeinsam mit den Verantwortlichen klare Zielwerte, Benchmarks und Performance-KPIs und machst die Zielerreichung messbar. Du analysierst die Customer Journey und den Conversion Funnel und identifizierst Potenziale zur Verbesserung von Conversion, Wiederkaufrate und Kundenwert. Du wertest A/B-Tests und Kampagnenexperimente aus und leitest fundierte Empfehlungen für die Weiterentwicklung unserer Marketingaktivitäten ab. Du stellst die Qualität, Konsistenz und Nachvollziehbarkeit unserer Marketingdaten sicher und entwickelst Kennzahlendefinitionen sowie Messmethoden weiter. Du treibst die Automatisierung und Standardisierung des Marketing-Reportings voran. Du arbeitest eng mit Marketing, Geschäftsführung, Finance, Data und Sales zusammen und bereitest Erkenntnisse verständlich und entscheidungsorientiert auf. Dein Profil Du hast ein abgeschlossenes Studium in BWL, Finance, Controlling, Wirtschaftswissenschaften oder eine vergleichbare Qualifikation. Besonders spannend ist Erfahrung aus E-Commerce, D2C, Retail, Fashion, FMCG oder einem schnell wachsenden Unternehmen . Du verstehst Marketing nicht nur technisch, sondern kannst erklären, welche operative Entscheidung hinter einer Veränderung steckt . Du bist extrem sicher in Excel oder Google Sheets und kannst auch große Datenmengen strukturiert analysieren. Erfahrung mit BI-Tools, ERP-Systemen und automatisierten Reportings ist ein großes Plus. Du arbeitest analytisch und präzise, verlierst dich aber nicht in Analysen, sondern kommst schnell zu einer klaren Empfehlung. Du hast den Anspruch, Zahlen zu challengen , statt sie lediglich entgegenzunehmen. Du kannst komplexe Sachverhalte so erklären, dass auch Nicht-Marketer verstehen, was zu tun ist. Du arbeitest eigenständig, übernimmst Verantwortung und fühlst dich in einem Umfeld wohl, in dem Entscheidungen schnell getroffen und Ergebnisse klar gemessen werden. Du verfügst über sehr gute Deutsch- und gute Englischkenntnisse. Deine Vorteile bei Pammys Echter Einfluss: Deine Analysen landen nicht in einer Präsentation, sondern direkt in operativen und strategischen Entscheidungen. Unternehmerisches Controlling: Du bekommst eigene Verantwortungsbereiche und wirst zum Sparringspartner für die jeweiligen Führungskräfte. Außergewöhnliche Skalierung: Du begleitest ein Unternehmen auf dem Weg vom mittleren 8-stelligen in den mittleren 9-stelligen Umsatzbereich. Komplexität, an der du wachsen kannst: E-Commerce, Marketing, internationale Märkte, eigene Logistik, Sourcing und Millionen von Produkten ergeben ein Finance-Umfeld, das weit über klassisches Controlling hinausgeht. Gestaltung statt Verwaltung: Viele Strukturen entstehen gerade erst. Du kannst Prozesse, Dashboards, KPIs und Steuerungsmodelle aktiv mit aufbauen. Kurze Entscheidungswege: Keine endlosen Abstimmungsschleifen. Gute Analysen werden schnell in Entscheidungen übersetzt. High-Performance-Umfeld: Klare Ziele, messbare Ergebnisse, hohe Eigenverantwortung und der Anspruch, jeden Bereich kontinuierlich besser zu machen. Entwicklungsperspektive: Mit dem weiteren Wachstum entstehen zusätzliche Verantwortungsbereiche und Führungsmöglichkeiten innerhalb unseres Finance-Teams. Metrics of Performance: Deal velocity (maintaining a fast, consistent sales cycle) and accurate, predictable Salesforce forecasting. Pillar 3: Revenue Activation & Orchestration Action: Seamlessly orchestrate the post-signature handover to the Account Management team, ensuring clients are strategically primed and incentivized to deploy freelancers immediately. Output: Rapid deployment of freelance talent within newly signed accounts. Metrics of Performance: Total Annual Contract Value (ACV) signed and the maximization of actual revenue generated within the first 12 months post-MSA. A documented track record of conquering "Big Local Players" in the German market, rather than coasting on brand recognition from large multinational HQs. Demonstrated success selling within the Professional Services or SaaS industries (ideally both). Deep, practical fluency in SPIN and MEDDIC methodologies. Skills You Will Deploy & Develop: Mastering complex, multi-stakeholder procurement navigation (aligning HR, Tech, and Sourcing/Buying centers). Architecting digital transformation acceleration for traditional high-growth Mittelstand businesses. Advanced pipeline integrity and CRM (Salesforce) command, merging execution rigor with strategic business acumen. The Self-Selection Filter ❓ This role is perfect for you if: You possess an entrepreneurial, high-agency mindset and inherently know how to build your own strategy from the ground up. You are a pure hunter who thrives on reaching out, sparking interest in cold accounts, and converting them into massive revenue drivers. You value deep methodology, structure, and execution rigor over simply being "a good talker". This role is NOT for you if: You expect a fully built, warm book of business handed to you on day one. You require intensive, constant coaching to execute basic sales fundamentals (our leadership expects plug-and-play seniority). You lack the organizational discipline to independently manage and ruthlessly qualify a targeted list of 50 accounts every quarter. 30-60-90 Day Impact Plan (The "Result") 🏁 Day 30: Complete your onboarding week in our Paris office, deeply understanding our marketplace mechanics and culture. Output: Map your initial 50 target accounts and finalize your customized hunter strategy. Day 60: Actively qualify and disqualify target accounts while executing in-depth discovery sessions with key C-Level and HR directors. Output: Establish a predictable, Meddic-qualified pipeline within Salesforce. Day 90: Secure initial Master Service Agreements (MSAs) and orchestrate frictionless handovers to the Account Management team. Metric of Performance: Take full ownership of maximizing actual revenue realization within your first major signed accounts. How to join the mission? 🚀 First call with Niko , our Talent Acquisition Lead, to better understand your background, and aspirations and answer your questions (45 minutes) Interview with your future manager , Jean-Charles Shadili , Head of Sales SMB, to discuss your experience and the role in more detail (45-60min) Business case in order to assess your technical sales skills and pitch delivery (60min) Lastly, you will meet Jihane ,  MD SMB , to better understand our global vision. (30min) Life on planet Malt is the perfect space to thrive personally and professionally 💫   🤝 Onboarding: Before easing into your new role, you’ll spend your first week learning about our culture, products, and services with other onboardees at our office in Paris. 💻 Remote work: Hybrid remote policy - 3 days office / 2 days home-office. 🏖️ Annual leave: 30 days/year. 📆 Sabbatical: 1 month paid sabbatical once you've been with Malt for 3 years. 📈 Stock options: Every Malter is entitled to stock options.  🍽️  Lunch vouchers:   6,50€ per day / 15 days a month. 🐶 Dog friendly office: In the heart of Munich/Berlin! ❓ Choose your Benefit: Transport reimbursement, Gym membership, Organic Food voucher or Rydes Mobility App. 📚 Free books: If you’re interested in learning more about any topic relevant to Malt’s business, just tell us the books you’d like to read, and we’ll order them for you—without any questions asked or approval processes to follow.   Ready? title: Senior Product Manager
description: <div class="content-intro"><h3><strong>Meet Yubico</strong></h3> <p>Yubico is a global leader in identity security and creator of the YubiKey, the original hardware-backed passkey. We are publicly traded on Nasdaq Stockholm; our global footprint includes headquarters in Stockholm, Sweden, Silicon Valley, California; and Singapore.</p> <p><strong>Why Join Our Mission?</strong></p> <p>At Yubico, we are guided by a shared belief that your work matters. We operate under a cultural philosophy of <em>Speed with Integrity</em>, pushing the boundaries of technology to secure the AI frontier—protecting both human and agentic AI interactions—and leading the transition to post-quantum cryptography. In everything we do, we live by our core values:</p> <ul> <li><strong>Battle Friction:</strong> We constantly look for new ways to simplify our products, our work, and the user experience.</li> <li><strong>Inspire Higher:</strong> We think big, champion the open internet, and strive to do the right thing even when it is difficult.</li> <li><strong>One Team:</strong> We are open, responsive, and collaborative, overcoming challenges and celebrating our successes together.</li> </ul> <p>Aligned with our commitment to open standards, we foster a thriving builder ecosystem through the<a href="https://developers.yubico.com/"> Yubico Developer Program</a>, offering free<a href="https://developers.yubico.com/Software_Projects/"> open-source repositories</a>, libraries, and SDKs to help developers rapidly integrate strong hardware authentication into any application. Through close collaborations with technical partners like Google, Microsoft, and Amazon, as well as newer frontiers like OpenAI, we continue to shape a safer digital world while donating security keys to protect vulnerable communities, journalists, and humanitarian groups worldwide through our <a href="https://www.yubico.com/why-yubico/secure-it-forward/"><em>Secure it Forward</em></a> program.</p></div><p><strong>At Yubico, we offer:</strong></p> <p><strong>Yubico Values: </strong>We work to ensure that our employees have an open space to have their voices amplified to create a workplace where everyone feels like they belong. In support of this, our employees have created some pretty cool Employee Resource Groups that foster inclusion, help build community and connection across Yubico. Additionally, Yubico donates YubiKeys to organizations in need all over the world (you can read more about our work <a href="https://www.yubico.com/why-yubico/secure-it-forward/">here</a>).</p> <p><strong>Social Connection:</strong> Relationships and connectedness matter, and we love spending time with our team! Our virtual workspace keeps us connected day-to-day whether it's through Yubico celebrating wins or our buzzing Slack communities. Check out our<a href="https://www.linkedin.com/company/yubico/life/17456342-be9b-4b35-b561-9ea3e892e9cc/"> Life at Yubico Page</a> on LinkedIn and our awards<a href="https://www.yubico.com/about/awards/"> here</a><strong>.</strong></p> <h2><strong>The Role</strong></h2> <p>Yubico is looking for an experienced and highly collaborative Senior Product Manager to define the product vision, strategy, and roadmap for the Tools, Libraries, and Applications (TLA) that underlie many of Yubico products and services. In this role, you will be a technical leader in our product management team and work closely with builders across a variety of our products&nbsp; from open source libraries and SDKs which empower other developers to create amazing things with our products, command line tools for managing and using YubiKeys and YubiHSMs, as well as graphical apps for mobile and desktop platforms.</p> <p>Our team works with authentication protocols like FIDO2/WebAuthn and uses cryptography to implement open standards. You'll have the opportunity to help us showcase our libraries in sample apps, making complex topics easier to use. You will help define and deliver the success of Yubico’s foundational product areas and expand the use of our technology to new and innovative areas that capture the market demand. You will serve as the strategic counterpart to our Senior Director of Engineering for Tools, Libraries &amp; Apps.</p> <p>This role will own the "what" and "why" behind the enterprise-grade, secured, and reliable software used to build new applications and services that expand the value of Yubico hardware and services. To succeed, you will work closely with other product managers, engineers, solutions engineers, and operations teams to translate complex business and technical requirements into a robust definition for the foundational tools, libraries and applications in our expanding product portfolio</p> <h2><strong>Tasks &amp; Responsibilities</strong></h2> <ul> <li><strong>Product Strategy &amp; Roadmap Ownership:</strong> Define and execute the long-term product vision and roadmap for our foundational tools, libraries, and applications, ensuring tight alignment with overarching business goals and customer needs.</li> <li><strong>Cross-Functional Collaboration:</strong> Partner deeply across Engineering, Product, Operations, and Security teams to design high-impact capabilities that enhance product foundations that underlie efficiency and scalability of our solutions.</li> <li><strong>Customer focus</strong>: Meet with customers to understand market demand and outcomes for new products</li> <li><strong>Requirements Definition:</strong> Translate complex workflows and software requirements into clear, high-quality product requirement documents (PRDs) and user stories.</li> <li><strong>Technical Partnership &amp; Conflict Resolution:</strong> Serve as the strategic unifier in cross-functional technical decisions. Actively synthesize competing priorities between product vision and architectural necessity, ensuring trade-offs are documented, data-backed, and optimized for long-term reliability.</li> <li><strong>Data-driven Insights</strong>: Provide data-driven insights on the specific products being managed, including sales and financial performance, year-over-year trends, pipeline, etc.</li> <li><strong>Full life cycle management: </strong>Manage the full life-cycle of a product from inception to end of life including: conception, market and requirements gathering, customer validation, creation of high-quality requirements document, management of engineering, marketing preparation, release and end-of-life processes</li> <li><strong>Security &amp; Compliance Management:</strong> Collaborate with security and engineering teams to ensure software systems seamlessly integrate with critical cryptographic infrastructure (such as PKI and HSMs) while maintaining Yubico's gold standard of security.</li> </ul> <h2><strong>Basic Qualifications</strong></h2> <ul> <li><strong>Education:</strong> Bachelor's Degree in Computer Science, Engineering, Business, or a related field (or equivalent experience).</li> <li><strong>Experience:</strong> 10+ years of progressively broadening product management experience, with a strong track record of shipping complex, enterprise-class hardware &amp; manufacturing solutions.</li> <li><strong>Domain Expertise:</strong> Proven experience in technical product management including development of large-scale internal tools.</li> <li><strong>Leadership &amp; Acumen:</strong> Proven ability to act as a constructive challenger to highly technical engineering partners. Strong business and technical acumen with the confidence to debate architectural tradeoffs and act as a constructive challenger in deeply technical environments and manage competing priorities across geographically distributed teams.</li> <li><strong>Communication:</strong> Exceptional communication and stakeholder management skills to align multi-disciplinary teams toward a unified vision.</li> </ul> <h2><strong>Preferred Qualifications</strong></h2> <ul> <li><strong>Cryptographic Systems: </strong>Understanding of cryptographic systems, Public Key Infrastructure (PKI), or Key Management Systems utilizing Hardware Security Modules (HSMs).</li> <li><strong>Analytical Mindset:</strong> Excellent analytical and problem-solving skills with a hands-on approach to diving deep into technical workflows alongside engineering teams.</li> </ul> <p><span style="text-decoration: underline;"><strong>U.S. benefits designed for your overall well-being:</strong></span></p> <p><strong>Health coverage.</strong> We’ve got you covered with top of the line health plans, including dental and vision. We pay 100% of your premium and 85% for your family.</p> <p><strong>Retirement plan.</strong> Our retirement plan includes a 401K dollar per dollar match up to 6% with a cap of $6K/year. Immediate vesting.</p> <p><strong>Wellness reimbursement.</strong> We offer $1,200.00 in wellness earnings (prorated based on start date) that you can use on your gym membership, a massage, or your favorite online fitness classes. This is a taxable benefit if you choose to participate.</p> <p><strong>Learning and development.</strong> We encourage your professional growth and offer a yearly development stipend of $3,000 and mentorship program.&nbsp;</p> <p><strong>Time off.</strong> We offer a total of 15 vacation days plus 10 holidays, and 7 sick days a year.</p> <p><strong>Paid parental leave.</strong> We love welcoming new family members to our YubiTeam! All parents receive 8 weeks of paid leave. Birthing parents receive an additional 8 weeks of paid leave (16 weeks total).&nbsp;</p> <p><strong>Commuter Benefits.</strong> If you need to commute to the office, we offer commuter benefits.&nbsp;</p> <p><strong>Strong mission &amp; company values.</strong> We’re a global team on a global mission to make the internet more secure for everyone. We believe that every person’s work matters. That you should always be nice, stay humble, and have fun, and never take yourself too seriously.</p> <p>#LI-BR1<br>#LI-Remote</p> <p>&nbsp;</p><div class="content-pay-transparency"><div class="pay-input"><div class="description"><p><span style="font-size: 16px;">Yubico offers a holistic Total Rewards package designed to support our employees in all aspects of their life inside and outside of work. This role has the annual salary range as defined below for a salary pay range for a candidate located in the San Francisco Bay Area. For roles that are filled in other locations, the compensation range will be based on data provided by the Radford McLagan Compensation Database from Aon. Final compensation is also based on a number of factors including, but not limited to, job-related knowledge, skills, and experience.</span></p></div><div class="title">Salary Pay Range</div><div class="pay-range"><span>$175,000</span><span class="divider">&mdash;</span><span>$210,000 USD</span></div></div></div><div class="content-conclusion"><p>We are an equal opportunity employer, we value diversity and uphold an inclusive environment where all people feel that they are equally respected and valued. All applicants will be considered for employment without attention to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, age, marital status, religion, national origin, disability, protected Veteran status or any other characteristic protected by law. We'd love to learn about what you can add to our diverse team. We are an E-Verify Participating Employer.</p> <p><strong>&nbsp;</strong></p> <p>Yubico does not accept agency resumes or referrals so please do not send them to our careers staff or employees. Yubico is not responsible for any fees related to unsolicited resumes or referrals.</p> <p><strong>&nbsp;</strong></p> <p>Personal data submitted through this form is used for managing Yubico’s recruitment activities, which include facilitating any application you make, setting up and conducting interviews and tests for applicants, evaluating and assessing results and selecting candidates, and as otherwise needed in our recruitment and onboarding processes. The use of your personal data may also be necessary prior to entering into a contract with you (that is prior to offering you a job with Yubico). Your personal data will only be used for the purposes for which it was collected and in accordance with the <a href="https://www.yubico.com/support/terms-conditions/privacy-notice/">Yubico Privacy Notice</a>. We only keep your personal data for as long as necessary and in compliance with Yubico’s record retention policies. If you have asked us to, we will keep you informed of other opportunities at Yubico. We do this in various ways, including email and by phone. If at any time you do not want us to contact you or use your information as described herein please contact us at ----- to let us know and we will delete all such information. Providing your personal data is voluntary, but necessary to join our talent community, and if you do not agree to provide your data, we will not be able to consider you as part of our talent community.</p> <p><strong>&nbsp;</strong></p> <p>As part of providing the requested service, we will transfer your data to be processed by <a href="https://www.greenhouse.com/privacy-policy-june-27-2024" target="_blank">Greenhouse Software Inc.</a>,&nbsp;a service provider contracted by Yubico AB and/or its subsidiaries that meets legally mandated privacy requirements. The Yubico Privacy Notice offers more information about Yubico privacy practices, including the lawful basis for processing of personal data, how to lodge a complaint with the supervisory authority, and how to contact Yubico to exercise your data subject rights. In this notice, when we refer to "Yubico", "us", "we" or "our", we mean the Yubico group company or companies that you apply to, or correspond with, and which are responsible for any personal data collected about you.</p></div> Find Jobs in Germany on Arbeitnow

title: Systems Integration & QA Engineer (All genders)
description: About Us STARK is a new kind of defence technology company revolutionising the way autonomous systems are deployed across multiple domains. We design, develop, and manufacture high-performance unmanned systems that are software-defined, mass-scalable, and cost-effective — providing operators with a decisive edge in contested environments. We are focused on delivering deployable, high-performance systems — not future promises. In a time of rising threats, STARK is bolstering the technological edge of NATO Allies and their Partners to deter aggression and defend Europe, today. About the team Mission Simulation is STARK’s digital proving ground — the tactical environment where our entire ecosystem of UAVs, surface vessels, and EW systems converges. The Mission Simulation team is a small, specialized group based in Munich, working closely with our platform and C2 teams to integrate all multi-domain assets into high-fidelity, Software-in-the-Loop simulators. We move fast, ship realistic environments, and build for three core purposes: rigorous testing, high-stakes demos, and tactical training. There is no room for gamification. We simulate the reality of combat — from complex swarm logic to EW degradation — ensuring that developers can fail fast, and real soldiers can train safely before hitting the battlefield. Your mission As a Systems Integration & QA Engineer, you are the critical link between our physical simulation hardware and our software development team. You will physically assemble our simulator setups and rigorously test the software environments running on them. By building our QA processes from the ground up, you ensure that every simulation runs flawlessly, and you provide highly detailed, actionable feedback to our software engineers before any system is used for high-stakes training or customer demos. Responsibilities Assemble and configure physical simulator hardware setups, integrating PCs, networking gear, and tactical peripherals (e.g., VR, HOTAS) to create realistic testing environments. Execute comprehensive software testing within the Mission Simulation environment (e.g., VBS4, custom C++ modules) to identify bugs, performance bottlenecks, and tactical inaccuracies. Design and establish foundational QA testing protocols, test plans, and bug-tracking workflows from scratch. Collaborate directly with the software engineering team, translating simulator performance issues into clear, actionable technical feedback and bug reports. Validate software updates and new releases on the physical simulator setups to guarantee stability before they are deployed for customer demos or tactical training. Reproduce complex software and integration bugs systematically to assist developers in rapid resolution. Qualifications Degree in IT, Computer Science, Systems Engineering, or equivalent practical experience. 3+ years of experience in software QA testing, system integration, or a similar role bridging IT hardware and software development. Hands-on experience assembling IT/simulator hardware and configuring operating systems (Windows and Linux). Proven ability to define and build QA processes, write structured test plans, and manage bug-tracking workflows. Strong technical communication skills to effectively translate user-end bugs into actionable data for software developers. Professional working proficiency in English (both spoken and written). Nice to have Familiarity with simulation engines (e.g., VBS4, Unreal, Unity) or complex tactical gaming environments. Basic scripting skills (e.g., Python, PowerShell) to automate repetitive software testing or OS configuration tasks. Experience in the defense sector or foundational knowledge of military operations/tactics to help evaluate simulation realism. Find more English Speaking Jobs in Germany on Arbeitnow

Wir bieten Dir ein umfassendes Leistungspaket mit Versicherungs-, Vorsorge- und weiteren Benefits. Individualität ist unsere kollektive Stärke, die uns zu Innovationen antreibt und uns voranbringt. Wir verbinden Chips – und Menschen. Unsere Technology

Die steigenden Anforderungen der Halbleiterindustrie an leistungsfähigere Chips mit höherer Bandbreite und geringerem Energieverbrauch werden durch unsere Technologie adressiert. Wir ermöglichen die Verbindung von Chips mit Hochdurchsatz-Computernetzwerken bei minimaler Latenz.

Der entscheidende Faktor ist die Nutzung der einzigartigen physikalischen Eigenschaften von Graphen, um elektronische Datenverarbeitung mit photonischer Kommunikation zu vereinen. Dadurch können unzählige Chips miteinander interagieren, als wären sie ein einziges System. Unsere Graphen-Photonik-Innovation hebt Rechenleistung und Effizienz auf ein neues Niveau.

Kurz gesagt: Wir vernetzen Chips zu leistungsstarken, energieeffizienten Systemen und überwinden mit unserer Graphen-Technologie die bisherigen Grenzen der Konnektivität in der Halbleiterindustrie.

Transfer Pricing: Du verantwortest zentrale Transfer-Pricing-Themen und entwickelst unsere Strukturen und Dokumentation im Zuge unserer internationalen Expansion weiter.

Das bringst Du mit

  • Fundierte Erfahrung im Transfer Pricing

  • Sehr gute Kenntnisse der internationalen Tax Compliance

  • Erfahrung mit internationalen Gesellschaftsstrukturen und deren steuerlichen Anforderungen

  • Ausgeprägte Hands-on-Mentalität, Verantwortungsbewusstsein und Freude daran, Strukturen selbstständig aufzubauen

  • Sehr gute Deutsch- und Englischkenntnisse in Wort und Schrift

Was wir Dir bieten

Wir setzen uns für die Vereinbarkeit von Beruf und Privatleben ein, damit Karrieren sinnvoll und bereichernd sind. Wir verbinden Chips – und Menschen. Wir ermutigen qualifizierte Personen mit beliebigem Hintergrund, sich zu bewerben. Wir fördern ein integratives und unterstützendes Arbeitsumfeld, das Zusammenarbeit, Innovation und Wachstum schätzt. Schließ Dich unserem Team an und werde Teil eines Unternehmens, das in der Branche etwas bewirken will.

Warum diese Rolle?

IFRS-Transformation: Gestalte die Umstellung unseres internationalen Reportings auf IFRS zum 01.01.2027 aktiv mit.

Aufbau statt Verwaltung: Entwickle Group-Accounting-, Reporting- und Konsolidierungsstrukturen weiter und schaffe Standards, die mit unserem Wachstum skalieren.

Hoher Gestaltungsspielraum: Du hast die Möglichkeit, Prozesse, Richtlinien und Strukturen aktiv mitzuprägen und Deine fachliche Expertise direkt einzubringen.

Internationale Perspektive: Begleite den Aufbau unserer internationalen Gesellschaften und gestalte deren Integration in unsere zukünftige Gruppenstruktur mit.

Impact & Ownership: Deine Arbeit schafft die Grundlage für eine belastbare und international ausgerichtete Finance-Organisation.

Entwicklungsperspektive: Mit unserem Wachstum kann auch Dein Verantwortungsbereich wachsen – perspektivisch bis hin zur Verantwortung für Group Reporting & Consolidation und zum Aufbau eines Teams.

Scale-up mit Corporate-Anspruch: Du verbindest die Dynamik eines wachsenden Unternehmens mit anspruchsvollen Finance-Themen und der Möglichkeit, Strukturen von Grund auf mitzugestalten.

Über uns

Wir verstehen die Halbleiterindustrie als ein Universum voller Möglichkeiten. Wir erkennen Chancen und sehen das transformative Potenzial, das unsere Graphen-Lösungen für die Neugestaltung der Branche mit sich bringen.

Wir laden Dich ein, diesen Wandel gemeinsam mit uns voranzutreiben, indem wir kluge Köpfe mit einer gemeinsamen Vision zusammenbringen. Die steigenden Anforderungen der Halbleiterindustrie an leistungsfähigere Chips mit höherer Bandbreite und geringerem Energieverbrauch werden durch unsere Technologie adressiert. Wir ermöglichen die Verbindung von Chips mit Hochdurchsatz-Computernetzwerken bei minimaler Latenz.

Der entscheidende Faktor ist die Nutzung der einzigartigen physikalischen Eigenschaften von Graphen, um elektronische Datenverarbeitung mit photonischer Kommunikation zu vereinen. Dadurch können unzählige Chips miteinander interagieren, als wären sie ein einziges System. Unsere Graphen-Photonik-Innovation hebt Rechenleistung und Effizienz auf ein neues Niveau.

Group Accounting & IFRS: Du baust unsere Group-Accounting- und IFRS-Strukturen weiter auf und entwickelst sie im Zuge unserer internationalen Expansion kontinuierlich weiter.

  • Mehrjährige Erfahrung im Group Accounting, Konzernrechnungswesen, in der Konsolidierung oder im internationalen Reporting

  • Fundierte IFRS-Kenntnisse und Erfahrung mit internationalen Accounting-Strukturen

  • Erfahrung mit internationalen Gesellschaftsstrukturen und deren Accounting-Anforderungen

If you're excited by complex systems, high traffic, and data-driven decisions, and impact matters more to you than process, we want to hear from you. We use AI for everything in order to improve speed and quality. What You’ll Own: Data Pipelines & Integration: You design, develop, and maintain scalable ETL pipelines on Databricks to integrate data from various sources, including app and web products and marketing partner data, ensuring reliable and efficient data flow across the business. Context & Memory Management: You maintain structured project context for your AI tools, for example a CLAUDE.md-style instructions file, so they stay accurate and useful as pipelines and codebases grow, rather than relying on ad hoc prompts each time. Parallel Agentic Work: You run multiple AI coding agents on separate tickets at the same time where it makes sense, reviewing and integrating their output rather than writing every line serially yourself. AI-Assisted Communication: You're comfortable using AI to help manage day-to-day coordination, including in Slack, when it's the faster and more reliable way to keep things moving. Cross-Functional Collaboration: You work closely with engineering and ML teams to ensure seamless data flow and integration into the Data Lakehouse. Staying Ahead: You stay updated with industry best practices and emerging technologies in data engineering and applied AI, bringing new ideas and approaches to the team. What You Bring Technical Foundation: You have a degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or Information Systems, or bootcamp experience, with a minimum of 4 years of professional experience in data engineering. Current, Deep Databricks Experience: You are proficient in designing, implementing, and optimizing ETL processes on Databricks, with at least a year of current, hands-on depth, not brief or dated exposure. Tools & Technologies: You have hands-on experience with Databricks and AWS services such as S3, Kinesis, and Lambda or similar technologies. title: Associate Director, Supply Chain
description: <p><strong>Associate Director, Supply Chain</strong></p> <p><strong>Company:</strong>&nbsp; Cycle Pharmaceuticals Ltd</p> <p><strong>Position Summary: </strong>This is a full-time position leading our Supply Chain department, working in our Cambridge office on a hybrid basis (minimum 3 days in the office).&nbsp;&nbsp;</p> <p>&nbsp;</p> <p><strong>The Opportunity</strong></p> <p>We have an exciting opportunity for an Associate Director of Supply Chain to lead our supply chain function within the business. You’ll combine your strategic ownership with hands-on execution shaping our global supply chain strategy ensuring, reliable, compliant and cost-effective product supply to patients through an outsourced partner network.</p> <p>This includes managing relationships with contract manufacturers, packaging and logistics providers, distributors, serialisation partners and other critical external suppliers to ensure a resilient, compliant and responsive supply chain.</p> <p>Reporting to the Chief Operations and Regulatory Officer, you will work closely with Executive Leadership and colleagues across Regulatory Affairs, Quality Assurance, Commercial and Finance, as well as a diverse network of external partners. You will also lead and develop the Supply Chain function, creating the capability, relationships and ways of working needed to support continued growth.</p> <p>This is a role for a commercially minded and collaborative supply chain leader who enjoys operating in a fast-paced, entrepreneurial environment. You will have the autonomy to shape strategy, solve complex supply challenges and drive continuous improvement, while helping build a supply chain capable of supporting the next stage of the company's growth.</p> <p><strong>&nbsp;</strong></p> <p><strong>Our Company&nbsp;</strong></p> <p>At Cycle Pharmaceuticals, we believe that <strong>Every Single Patient Matters</strong>. This is at the heart of why we work. As we look to grow, we’re now looking for people to join our team who share our vision. We know that life-changing treatments need life-improving product support to match, because when you put the two together, great things can happen.</p> <p>Our core focus areas include rare metabolic, oncology, immunological, and neurological genetic conditions, where we improve existing drugs, repurpose them for new uses, and bring generics back to market. Using cutting-edge drug delivery technologies, we enhance the efficiency of treatments, offering patients greater freedom and choice.</p> <p>If you want to know more about what we do then, why not check out our website below and look at some of our patient stories:&nbsp;<a href="https://cyclepharma.com/patient-advocacy/patient-stories/">Patient Stories - Cycle Pharma</a></p> <p>&nbsp;</p> <p><strong>What you’ll be doing in this role:</strong></p> <p><strong>&nbsp;</strong></p> <p><strong>Supply Chain Strategy, Planning and Operations</strong></p> <ul> <li>Develop and execute supply chain strategies aligned to commercial priorities, product launches, lifecycle management and the organisation’s broader growth ambitions.</li> <li>Provide clear, evidence-based, risk-adjusted recommendations on supply priorities, inventory trade-offs, supplier performance and escalation requirements, enabling timely, transparent and commercially informed decision-making.</li> <li>Provide strategic oversight of the end-to-end supply chain, including demand and supply planning, inventory management, manufacturing scheduling, distribution and product availability, ensuring a reliable and responsive supply network.</li> <li>Lead the Sales &amp; Operations Planning (S&amp;OP) process, bringing together commercial forecasts, customer demand, inventory strategy and manufacturing capacity to create a clear, aligned view of supply and demand. Proactively identify, communicate and mitigate emerging risks.</li> <li>Establish and optimise inventory policies and supply strategies that balance product availability, supply resilience, risk and working capital requirements.</li> <li>Define and maintain meaningful supply chain KPIs and performance measures, using data and insight to identify opportunities, strengthen accountability and drive continuous improvement across the supply network.</li> <li>Support business development initiatives, new product introductions and other growth initiatives, assessing supply chain requirements and developing scalable, compliant and fit-for-purpose supply solutions.</li> <li>Own the annual Supply Chain budget, identifying opportunities to improve efficiency, optimise costs and deliver value while maintaining regulatory compliance, supply resilience and product availability.</li> </ul> <p>&nbsp;</p> <p><strong>Supply Chain Governance and Operational Excellence</strong></p> <ul> <li>Lead strategic relationships with contract manufacturers, packaging providers, logistics partners, distributors, serialization providers and other critical supply chain partners, ensuring clear accountability and delivery against agreed service, quality and business requirements.</li> <li>Establish and maintain effective supplier governance, including structured performance reviews, service-level management, quality oversight, issue resolution and improvement plans, ensuring external partners consistently meet expectations.</li> <li>Work closely with Quality Assurance and relevant functions to ensure the external supply network operates in accordance with applicable GxP, GDP, DSCSA and other regulatory requirements.</li> <li>Lead the resolution and escalation of complex supply, quality, compliance and operational issues, coordinating internal teams and external partners to minimise business impact and protect product availability.</li> <li>Drive the development of scalable supply chain processes, improving visibility, data quality, operational efficiency and ways of working as the organisation and product portfolio grow.</li> <li>Provide governance and oversight of critical supply chain systems and data, including ERP, serialization, GS1 and inventory management platforms, ensuring robust master data, system integrity and reliable reporting.</li> <li>Establish a culture of accountability and continuous improvement across the external supply network, using supplier performance insights, operational data and emerging risks to identify and deliver sustainable improvements.</li> </ul> <p>&nbsp;</p> <p><strong>People Leadership</strong></p> <ul> <li>Lead and develop the Supply Chain function, setting clear priorities, expectations and ways of working while creating a culture of ownership, collaboration, continuous improvement and high performance.</li> <li>Build team capability and succession strength through coaching, mentoring and targeted development, ensuring the function has the skills, expertise and capacity to support the organisation’s future growth.</li> <li>Develop strong, collaborative relationships with senior stakeholders, providing clear supply chain insight and challenge to support informed business decisions and representing Supply Chain effectively across cross-functional leadership and governance forums.</li> </ul> <p>&nbsp;</p> <p><strong>The following skills and experience will be important in helping you to succeed </strong><strong>in this role:</strong></p> <ul> <li>Degree (or equivalent experience) in Supply Chain Management, Business Operations, or Life Sciences.</li> <li>Significant pharmaceutical, biotechnology, or healthcare supply chain experience, including leadership responsibility for outsourced manufacturing and distribution networks.</li> <li>Collaborative mindset with the ability to work across cross-functional teams and build strong internal and external relationships.&nbsp;</li> <li>Strong understanding of demand planning, inventory management, contract manufacturing, logistics, supplier management, and supply chain compliance.</li> <li>Knowledge of GDP, DSCSA, serialisation, and global pharmaceutical supply chain regulations.</li> <li>Experience leading cross-functional projects, product launches, and business-critical supply chain initiatives.</li> <li>Demonstrated ability to influence senior stakeholders and manage complex external partnerships.</li> <li>Excellent analytical, leadership, communication, and problem-solving skills.</li> </ul> <p>&nbsp;</p> <p><strong>What can we offer to you:</strong></p> <p>In addition to being part of a great team and doing things that will make a real difference to patients’ lives, you will enjoy all the benefits that brings:</p> <ul> <li>A collaborative high performing work environment</li> <li>Performance based bonus</li> <li>Opportunity to join a fast growing and ambitious business</li> <li>Company pension scheme</li> <li>100% employer paid membership for Private Health Insurance</li> <li>Life and Critical Illness Insurance</li> <li>Corporate Gym membership</li> <li>Regular team building events and an agile working environment</li> </ul> <p>&nbsp;</p> <p><strong>Diversity and Inclusion statement:</strong></p> <p><em>At Cycle Pharmaceuticals, we are committed to creating an inclusive, respectful, positive and diverse workplace. We do not discriminate on the basis of race, colour, religion, gender, age,&nbsp;</em><em>disability, or any other protected characteristic. We actively support and embrace diversity, and we are working to build a team that reflects a wide range of backgrounds and perspectives.</em></p> <p><em>We value your unique contributions and encourage you to join us in shaping a more inclusive future. If you require any reasonable adjustments - whether during the application process or in the workplace - we will be happy to support your needs. At Cycle, equality, inclusion, and respect are at the core of everything we do. We fully comply with all applicable employment laws, including those related to non-discrimination, work authorization, and employment eligibility verification.</em></p> Find Jobs in United Kingdom on Arbeitnow

description: <div class="content-intro"><p><strong>About Pallet </strong></p> <p class="isSelectedEnd">Pallet is building AI Agents to transform the physical economy — a $12 trillion global industry. We’ve raised $50M from top investors, including General Catalyst, Bessemer Venture Partners, and Bain Capital Ventures. In under two years, we’ve achieved 700% revenue growth and are just getting started.</p> <p class="isSelectedEnd">Our mission is to increase the efficiency of the global supply chain by automating the manual workflows that slow supply chain teams down — from scheduling and appointment setting to data entry and load management. Our flagship platform provides end-to-end visibility, control, and optimization, while our newest product, CoPallet, introduces AI Agents that can understand and execute requests in real time and integrate directly with customer systems.</p> <p class="isSelectedEnd">As companies across the physical economy look to generative AI to drive efficiency, many are turning to Pallet to lead the way. With deep supply chain expertise and cutting-edge AI capabilities, we’re positioned to build the next $10B company powering the physical economy.</p> <p>Join us and work alongside leaders from Google, DoorDash, YC, and more to shape the future of supply chain technology.</p></div><p><strong>London, United Kingdom (Remote to start, transitioning to 5 days/week in-office once our London office opens)</strong></p> <p><strong>You could be an Enterprise Account Executive anywhere. Why us?</strong></p> <ul> <li>Join a well-funded, high-growth startup on a clear path to $100M ARR.</li> <li>Sell a category-defining AI Agents platform with massive surface area across logistics.</li> <li>Build Pallet’s presence across Europe as one of the first commercial hires on the ground.</li> <li>Work directly with founders and senior leadership to define our international go-to-market strategy.</li> <li>Help transform one of the world’s largest industries while building toward a $10B+ outcome.</li> </ul> <p><strong>About the opportunity</strong></p> <p>We’re hiring our first Enterprise Account Executives in EMEA to build Pallet’s commercial presence across Europe.</p> <p>You’ll own net-new enterprise acquisition across the region, build relationships with the largest logistics providers in Europe, and help establish the playbook for our international expansion. This is a highly consultative enterprise sales role focused on educating customers on an entirely new category of AI-powered workflow automation.</p> <p>You’ll partner closely with Sales, Product, Engineering, Solutions, and Customer Success to drive a solution-selling motion centered around workflow discovery, AI use case identification, structured pilots, and measurable ROI.</p> <p>Initially, this role will be remote from London while we establish our UK presence. Once our London office opens, this role will transition to working from the office five days per week when not traveling to customer sites.</p> <p><strong>How you will make an impact</strong></p> <ul> <li>Own the full enterprise sales cycle across EMEA, from outbound prospecting through contract signature.</li> <li>Build and maintain a 3x-4x qualified pipeline through disciplined outbound execution while self-sourcing at least 30% of opportunities.</li> <li>Develop relationships with executive stakeholders across Europe’s largest logistics providers, including COO, CIO, VP Operations, VP Supply Chain, and VP Technology.</li> <li>Lead consultative discovery sessions that map operational workflows to Pallet’s AI agent capabilities.</li> <li>Scope and lead structured pilots that demonstrate measurable operational ROI and convert into enterprise deployments.</li> <li>Build executive business cases that align operational improvements with financial outcomes.</li> <li>Document repeatable customer use cases and market feedback to shape Pallet’s product roadmap and international GTM strategy.</li> <li>Help establish Pallet as the leading AI platform for enterprise logistics across Europe.</li> </ul> <p><strong>What we’re looking for</strong></p> <ul> <li>8+ years of enterprise B2B SaaS or enterprise logistics sales experience.</li> <li>Business-fluent Spanish: you can run discovery, negotiate and present to executives in Spanish.&nbsp;</li> <li>Proven track record of consistently closing six- and seven-figure enterprise software agreements.</li> <li>Strong consultative selling and value-based sales methodology.</li> <li>Experience navigating complex buying committees and long enterprise sales cycles.</li> <li>Executive presence with senior operators and technology leaders.</li> <li>Comfortable selling technical, workflow-heavy software products.</li> <li>Ability to quickly understand complex logistics operations and translate them into compelling AI automation opportunities.</li> <li>Excellent outbound prospecting and territory-building discipline.</li> <li>Willingness to travel extensively across Europe.</li> </ul> <p>Experience selling into logistics, supply chain, transportation, or warehouse operations is strongly preferred but not required. Candidates without logistics experience should demonstrate an ability to quickly learn operational workflows and become trusted advisors to customers.</p> <p><strong>Working model</strong></p> <p>This role is based in London.</p> <p>Working hours are generally <strong>9:00am-6:00pm London time</strong>, providing full coverage of the European business day while maintaining regular collaboration with our San Francisco headquarters.</p> <p>You’ll typically spend:</p> <ul> <li>Mornings and early afternoons working directly with European customers and prospects.</li> <li>Late afternoons collaborating with our US-based Sales, Product, and Engineering teams during our daily overlap window.</li> <li>Approximately 75% of your time traveling across Europe for customer meetings, executive workshops, pilots, and industry events.</li> </ul> <p>Initially this role will be remote from London. description: <div class="content-intro"><h3><strong>Who we are:</strong></h3> <p>Burson, part of WPP, is the global communications leader built to create value for clients through reputation. With highly specialized teams, industry-leading technologies and breakthrough creative, we help brands and businesses redefine reputation as a competitive advantage so they can lead today and into the future. When you work at Burson, you are part of a global community of lifelong learners who thrive at the edge of innovation.</p> <p>WPP (LSE/NYSE: WPP) is the trusted growth partner for the world’s leading brands. We unite cutting-edge media intelligence and data solutions, world-class creativity, next-generation production, transformative enterprise solutions and expert strategic counsel in a single company – powered by exceptional talent and our agentic marketing platform, WPP Open, to help our clients navigate change, capture opportunity and deliver transformational growth. For more information, visit <a href="WPP.com">WPP.com</a>&nbsp;</p> <p>For more information visit&nbsp;<a href="https://www.bursonglobal.com/">bursonglobal.com</a> and follow us on <a href="https://www.linkedin.com/company/burson/posts/?feedView=all">LinkedIn</a> and&nbsp;<a href="https://www.instagram.com/burson.global/?hl=en">Instagram</a>.</p></div><p><strong>More About&nbsp;The&nbsp;Role</strong>&nbsp;<br>This role&nbsp;sits within the&nbsp;Corporate&nbsp;Sectors&nbsp;and Public&nbsp;Affairs&nbsp;teams&nbsp;at Burson as a Social &amp; Content&nbsp;Strategist&nbsp;(Account Director). You will&nbsp;be&nbsp;working&nbsp;as part of a global social media team for a leading technology company,&nbsp;as well as supporting&nbsp;other key accounts,&nbsp;creating social-first content for&nbsp;Instagram, TikTok,&nbsp;LinkedIn,&nbsp;Facebook&nbsp;and&nbsp;X.&nbsp;&nbsp;</p> <p>You will&nbsp;be responsible for&nbsp;developing social&nbsp;strategies that<u>:</u>&nbsp;connect audience&nbsp;behaviour&nbsp;with brand&nbsp;objectives.&nbsp;You will partner&nbsp;closely&nbsp;with&nbsp;creative&nbsp;teams, account leaders, and clients to guide the direction of&nbsp;campaigns&nbsp;across platforms.&nbsp;Your work will influence&nbsp;content planning, creative development,&nbsp;community engagement, and measurement approaches.&nbsp;</p> <p>We are looking for someone who&nbsp;is passionate &nbsp;&nbsp;about&nbsp;social platforms,&nbsp;embraces&nbsp;new&nbsp;content&nbsp;formats<u> </u>and with strong client management skills and the flexibility to work across different types of social platforms.&nbsp;</p> <p><strong>What You’ll Do</strong>&nbsp;</p> <ul> <li>Develop and implement robust, data-driven social media&nbsp;and digital engagement&nbsp;strategies by conducting in-depth&nbsp;reputational&nbsp;analysis, trend forecasting, and&nbsp;stakeholder&nbsp;/ audience&nbsp;mapping, ensuring these strategies are not only clear and compelling but also directly aligned with overarching business&nbsp;objectives&nbsp;and measurable KPIs.&nbsp;</li> </ul> <ul> <li>Lead&nbsp;and optimise strategic social platform planning for both large-scale, time-bound campaigns and continuous 'always-on' engagement initiatives, meticulously defining channel-specific content ecosystems, targeting parameters, and maximising reach and impact across the relevant digital landscape.&nbsp;</li> </ul> <ul> <li>Translate performance data, intelligence, and&nbsp;stakeholder&nbsp;sentiment into actionable strategic recommendations that directly inspire and inform innovative creative development, campaign optimisation, and future content planning.&nbsp;</li> </ul> <ul> <li>Persuasively present complex strategic frameworks, insights, and actionable plans to both internal stakeholders and external clients, instilling confidence and securing buy-in through clear, compelling communication and a proven executive presence.&nbsp;&nbsp;</li> </ul> <ul> <li>At the client level:&nbsp;Leverage&nbsp;our suite of tools to&nbsp;anticipate&nbsp;threats&nbsp;and inform innovative strategic pivots&nbsp;for our clients&nbsp;that&nbsp;build&nbsp;reputation, strategic&nbsp;relevance&nbsp;and competitive advantage.&nbsp;</li> </ul> <ul> <li>At the practice level:&nbsp;Proactively&nbsp;monitor&nbsp;and interpret evolving social media trends, platform evolutions, and shifts in audience behaviour to&nbsp;identify&nbsp;emerging opportunities&nbsp;for our clients, teams and to keep Burson ahead of the curve.&nbsp;You will join a&nbsp;vibrant&nbsp;community of Social&nbsp;&amp; Content&nbsp;contributors across our London office, working together to grow and innovate the offer.</li> </ul> <p><strong>Experience that contributes to success </strong></p> <ul> <li>Embed&nbsp;seamlessly into our Corporate and Public Affairs&nbsp;team, working across our specialisms to understand our clients and the&nbsp;factors shaping reputation across&nbsp;stakeholders,&nbsp;media,&nbsp;policy, regulation, issues and more.&nbsp;&nbsp;</li> </ul> <ul> <li>Collaborate&nbsp;with creative teams, guiding the development of concepts and content designed to authentically connect with and deeply resonate&nbsp;with target stakeholders,<u> </u>ensuring messaging is&nbsp;reputationally&nbsp;relevant and highly engaging.&nbsp;</li> </ul> <ul> <li>Creating&nbsp;effective&nbsp;content briefs&nbsp;for&nbsp;our design team,&nbsp;developing copy and making recommendations on assets&nbsp;and overseeing digital editorial calendars.&nbsp;</li> </ul> <ul> <li>Proactively&nbsp;monitor&nbsp;and interpret evolving social media trends, platform evolutions, and shifts in audience behaviour to&nbsp;identify&nbsp;emerging opportunities,&nbsp;anticipate&nbsp;competitive&nbsp;threats, and inform innovative strategic pivots that&nbsp;maintain&nbsp;brand&nbsp;relevance and competitive advantage.&nbsp;</li> </ul> <ul> <li>Articulate and persuasively present complex strategic frameworks, insights, and actionable plans to both internal stakeholders and external clients, instilling confidence and securing buy-in through clear, compelling communication and a proven executive presence.&nbsp;</li> </ul> <ul> <li>Creating content briefs to feed into our design and editing team, developing&nbsp;copy&nbsp;and making recommendations on assets and content structure&nbsp;and overseeing the management&nbsp;social calendar across multiple regions for a global LinkedIn company page&nbsp;&nbsp;</li> </ul> <ul> <li>Managing client communications including leading content development workstreams, updating WIPs and calendars, internal communication with colleagues&nbsp;&nbsp;</li> </ul><div class="content-conclusion"><h3><strong>You belong at Burson:</strong></h3> <p>Our vision is for Burson to be the leading ‘academy company’ for creative communications professionals and emerging leaders. We provide a dynamic environment where ambitious colleagues come to elevate their skills, expand their networks, and ultimately, produce the best solutions for today’s leading brands. Our commitment to your growth is reflected in our robust benefits and people programs, which include professional development opportunities, mentorship programs with industry leaders, a vibrant and inclusive company culture fostering collaboration and innovation and packages designed to reward and retain top talent. We invest in our people because we believe their success is our success.</p> <p>At Burson, we’re an agency of learn-it-alls. We recognize that the things we do best, creativity and communications, require a level of nuanced understanding. That’s why it’s imperative for us to hire extraordinarily talented people of all backgrounds and identities. Without that we can’t do the essential work of inspiring bold ideas, fostering constructive dialogue, cultivating meaningful experiences, and driving innovation and creativity for our partners. Your unique point of view—your talent—is what makes you a #BursonPerson, and it’s how we deliver exceptional results for our clients, together.</p> <p>We believe the best work happens when we're together, fostering creativity, collaboration, and connection. That's why we’ve adopted a hybrid approach, with teams in the office around four days a week. If you require accommodations or flexibility, please discuss this with the hiring team during the interview process.</p> <p>When you click the "Submit Application" button below, this will send any information you add below to Burson. Before you do this, we think it's a good idea to read through our &nbsp;<a href="https://www.bursonglobal.com/p/recruitment-privacy-notice">Recruitment Privacy Policy. </a>California residents should read our <a href="https://www.bursonglobal.com/p/california-recruitment-privacy-notice">California Recruitment Privacy Notice. </a>This explains what we do with your personal data when you apply for a role with us, and, how you can update the information you have provided us with or how to remove it.&nbsp;</p></div> Find more English Speaking Jobs in United Kingdom on Arbeitnow
