title: Graduate - Scale Space
description: <h1>Graduate Programme — Scale Space</h1> <ul data-spread="false"> <li>Are you torn between the excitement of start-ups and the stability of corporate life?</li> <li>Are you keen to continue learning and developing skills whilst experiencing how to build businesses?</li> <li>Are you looking for a role that will offer the opportunity to experience first-hand how a growing business operates, while being supported to take ownership of work that matters?</li> </ul> <p class="isSelectedEnd">If this sounds like you and you are up for the challenge, we would love to hear from you.</p> <p class="isSelectedEnd">We are looking to hire high-energy, entrepreneurial and value-adding graduate talent to join Blenheim Chalcot in a role dedicated entirely to<span class="Apple-converted-space">&nbsp;</span><strong>Scale Space</strong>, one of the businesses within the Blenheim Chalcot portfolio.</p> <h2>ABOUT US</h2> <p class="isSelectedEnd">At Blenheim Chalcot, we invest more than just funds. We invest our knowledge and experience, our ideas and infrastructure. Our ventures are at the forefront of a multitude of industries being disrupted by digital, including FinTech, EdTech, GovTech, Media, Sport, Charity and more.</p> <p class="isSelectedEnd">We are highly entrepreneurial and seek opportunities where digital technologies can disrupt major markets. Ventures we have built include ClearScore, Salary Finance, Modulr and the Rajasthan Royals cricket team.</p> <p class="isSelectedEnd">Many of the companies within the portfolio have materialised from ideas conceived and launched by us, and we have over 4,000 employees supporting their growth and development. Our assets under management stand at more than £1.8bn and total portfolio revenue is over £500 million.</p> <p class="isSelectedEnd">We work closely with investment and strategic partners including PayPal, FIS, L&amp;G, Tencent, Experian, Google, Worldpay, Imperial College and some of the leading venture capital and private equity companies internationally.</p> <p class="isSelectedEnd">Our central team, Venture Builder Services (VBS), exists to support our ventures to be successful quickly, sustainably and with access to best-practice tools, solutions and expertise. We provide a range of services to help new businesses get off the ground, including technology, growth, talent, finance, legal and tax.</p> <h2>IMPACT BEYOND PROFIT</h2> <p class="isSelectedEnd">15% of our partnerships and ventures are charities. These include the British Asian Trust, Babyzone and OnSide Youth Zones. In the same way that we support our ventures, our Partners provide direct hands-on support to these charities by being active board members and offering expert advice.</p> <h2>ABOUT SCALE SPACE</h2> <p class="isSelectedEnd">Scale Space is a community and workspace designed to bring together ambitious businesses, entrepreneurs, scale-ups and innovators.</p> <p class="isSelectedEnd">Based in White City, Scale Space provides more than just flexible workspace. It creates an environment where growing businesses can connect, collaborate and access the networks, expertise and opportunities they need to scale.</p> <p class="isSelectedEnd">The team works across community, events, partnerships, operations and customer experience to ensure that members receive a high-quality experience while helping to build a connected and ambitious business community.</p> <h2>THE GRADUATE OPPORTUNITY</h2> <p class="isSelectedEnd">Joining Blenheim Chalcot as a Graduate, you will gain hands-on experience in a fast-paced and progressive environment while working exclusively with<span class="Apple-converted-space">&nbsp;</span><strong>Scale Space</strong>.</p> <p class="isSelectedEnd">You will be embedded within the Scale Space team and contribute to meaningful projects across the business, while benefiting from Blenheim Chalcot's learning, development and employee benefits.</p> <p class="isSelectedEnd">For you as a graduate, this opportunity involves:</p> <ul data-spread="true"> <li><strong>Dedicated to Scale Space</strong><span class="Apple-converted-space">&nbsp;</span>– although you will be employed by Blenheim Chalcot, your role will sit fully within Scale Space. Your day-to-day work, projects and objectives will be focused entirely on supporting Scale Space and its growth, giving you the opportunity to build deep experience within a fast-moving and entrepreneurial business.</li> <li><strong>Training &amp; Development</strong><span class="Apple-converted-space">&nbsp;</span>– we pride ourselves on having an intentional and continuous learning and development culture at Blenheim Chalcot. You will have access to BC learning and development opportunities designed to strengthen your core professional, commercial and leadership skills, while applying that learning directly to your work at Scale Space. You will learn by doing, taking on real responsibility and developing quickly within the Scale Space team.</li> <li><strong>Early Careers Development</strong><span class="Apple-converted-space">&nbsp;</span>– as a BC graduate, you will have access to structured development opportunities designed for those early in their careers. These will support your professional growth while your substantive role remains fully dedicated to Scale Space.</li> <li><strong>Graduate Community</strong><span class="Apple-converted-space">&nbsp;</span>– you will be part of the wider BC graduate community, with access to relevant learning sessions, networking opportunities and socials. This community is intended to support your development and connection with fellow graduates; your substantive role and day-to-day responsibilities will remain entirely within Scale Space.</li> <li><strong>Accountability</strong><span class="Apple-converted-space">&nbsp;</span>– you will be given meaningful responsibility from the outset and supported to take ownership of work that matters. Rather than rotating between businesses, you will build continuity and depth within Scale Space and see the direct impact of your work on the business, its members and the wider community.</li> </ul> <h2>ARE YOU BC?</h2> <p class="isSelectedEnd">We are not expecting you to have worked in start-ups before or to have studied a tech-related degree. For us, it is about hiring the right person and their potential, not just their experience.</p> <p class="isSelectedEnd">As such, we are looking for graduates from any discipline. Different areas of expertise bring valuable new perspectives.</p> <p class="isSelectedEnd">We look for some key fundamentals in people when hiring into the BC Group. We look for people who are:</p> <ul data-spread="true"> <li><strong>Curious</strong><span class="Apple-converted-space">&nbsp;</span>– people in BC are inquisitive. They want to understand ‘why’ and consider whether there is a better approach rather than simply accepting ‘it’s how we’ve always done it’. Given our ethos is all about disrupting industries with new methods and products, curiosity is at the heart of what we do.</li> <li><strong>‘Doers’</strong><span class="Apple-converted-space">&nbsp;</span>– we are a community of proactive self-starters. We will provide full support to our graduates, but we look for people who can use their initiative, take ownership and drive work forward on a daily basis.</li> <li><strong>Flexible Mindset</strong><span class="Apple-converted-space">&nbsp;</span>– working in a growth business environment is ambiguous, diverse and, at times, chaotic by definition. Being adaptable and recognising the importance of flexibility in order to add value in a constantly evolving company is vital.</li> <li><strong>Enthusiasm</strong><span class="Apple-converted-space">&nbsp;</span>– you do not need to be a ‘techy’ at heart to work in our environment. We are looking for people who are enthusiastic about innovation, growth and the changing nature of industries, with a desire to work in an environment where new and challenging things happen every day.</li> <li><strong>Humble &amp; Sociable</strong><span class="Apple-converted-space">&nbsp;</span>– building and scaling businesses is never easy. As such, we have a ‘no-ego’ policy and seek out people who bring energy to a team rather than drain it. We have a down-to-earth and personable culture; we solve complex problems but do not take ourselves too seriously.</li> </ul> <p class="isSelectedEnd">If you see yourself in this and would like to work with similarly minded people, we would love to hear from you.</p> <h2>WHAT WE CAN OFFER YOU AS A BC EMPLOYEE</h2> <ul data-spread="false"> <li>Be part of the UK’s leading digital venture builder and have the opportunity to learn from the incredible talent across BC.</li> <li>Be exposed to the right mix of challenge, responsibility and learning and development opportunities while building deep, hands-on experience within Scale Space.</li> <li>A fun and open, if a little cricket-obsessed, atmosphere.</li> <li>Discretionary bonus.</li> <li>25 days of paid holiday plus your birthday off.</li> <li>Life Assurance, Pension Scheme and Cycle to Work Scheme.</li> <li>Flexible Benefits including Private Medical and Dental cover and gym subsidies.</li> </ul> <h2>APPLICATION &amp; PROCESS</h2> <p class="isSelectedEnd">If you are keen to apply, please submit your CV and a member of our Talent Team will contact you with next steps.</p> <p class="isSelectedEnd">We have a rigorous recruitment process, which we use for all our roles to ensure we attract the very best talent.</p> <p class="isSelectedEnd">We have a three-stage process:</p> <p class="isSelectedEnd"><strong>Stage 1:</strong><span class="Apple-converted-space">&nbsp;</span>Telephone interview with a member of the BC Talent Team.</p> <p class="isSelectedEnd"><strong>Stage 2:</strong><span class="Apple-converted-space">&nbsp;</span>Virtual assessment day, consisting of both individual and group activities.</p> <p class="isSelectedEnd"><strong>Stage 3:</strong><span class="Apple-converted-space">&nbsp;</span>Final interviews with Blenheim Chalcot and Scale Space at Scale Space, White City.</p> <p class="isSelectedEnd"><em>Please note that the timeframes provided above are subject to change. Any changes will be communicated throughout the process.</em></p> <p class="isSelectedEnd">Blenheim Chalcot is a proud Equal Opportunity Employer. Diversity is one of our core values and is central to our business. We strive to maximise the diversity of our workforce and welcome applications from everyone.</p> <p class="isSelectedEnd">We encourage diversity of perspective, background, identity and thought, while fostering an environment where everyone can express themselves regardless of race, religion, sex, gender, colour, national origin, disability or any other legally protected characteristic.</p> <p>We are committed to continuing to nurture an inclusive environment and building a diverse workforce.</p><div class="content-conclusion"><p>By submitting your CV you understand that we have a legitimate interest to use your personal data for the purposes of assessing your eligibility for this role.&nbsp; This means that we may use your personal data to contact you to discuss your CV or arrange an interview, or transfer your CV to the hiring manager(s) of the role you have applied for.&nbsp; You can ask us at any time to remove your CV from our database by emailing&nbsp;<a ---------- but please note that this means we will no longer consider you for the role you have applied for.&nbsp;You can review our privacy policy<a href="https://www.blenheimchalcot.com/recruitment-privacy-policy/">&nbsp;here</a>.</p></div> Find Jobs in United Kingdom on Arbeitnow

title: Graduate Customer Intelligence Executive - French Speaking
description: <p>&nbsp;</p> <p>Fospha is the measurement system enterprise retail and ecommerce brands run their business on. We give marketing teams one clear, daily view of what's actually working — across every channel and everywhere they sell, from their website to Amazon and TikTok Shop — down to the level of a single ad or piece of creative. It replaces guesswork and gut feel with a number marketing, finance and agencies can all trust and act on.</p> <p>Brands including Dyson, Gymshark, Adanola and Huel use Fospha up to 25 times a day to decide where budget should move next. We've spent over a decade building this, with more than $40 billion in marketing spend now optimised through the platform — and we're scaling fast across London, Mumbai and Austin.</p> <p>&nbsp;</p> <p><strong>About the role</strong></p> <p>The Customer Intelligence team are responsible for ensuring our customers take action on Fospha data: turning data into clear recommendations, guiding marketers through budgeting decisions and helping client teams become experts in the Fospha platform.</p> <p>This is the entry point into the function, and it is a hands-on one. You'll work across live customer accounts from the point that they go live with Fospha, becoming the trusted expert in the domain, our customers and the decisions they are making across their marketing mix. It's a role for someone who wants to learn how to turn data into customer action, in a business where these actions are meaningful and exciting.</p> <ul> <li><strong>Team</strong>: Customer Intelligence</li> <li><strong>Level</strong>: Graduate - Entry Level</li> <li><strong>Location</strong>: London, White City<br><br></li> </ul> <p><strong>What you’ll be doing:</strong></p> <ul> <li>You'll join our Customer Intelligence Team and work across customer accounts, becoming a trusted expert in the insight, model, and data quality that sit behind them</li> <li>You'll be responsible for the customer outcomes your team owns — driving action on insight, trust in the model, and confidence in data quality — contributing to customer retention alongside the Account Manager</li> <li>You'll build deep expertise in your specialism and use it to solve real customer problems, turning data into clear recommendations, building trust in our methodology, and keeping data accurate and flowing</li> <li>You'll be confident and effective in customer-facing moments relevant to your team, building credibility with both technical and non-technical stakeholders</li> <li>You'll be collaborative, working closely with Account Managers and other specialist teams, feeding customer insight back to Product, and keeping everyone aligned with regular progress updates</li> </ul> <p>In addition to your core responsibilities, we expect you to be excited by the opportunity Gen AI brings and find new ways of working utilising our Gen AI hub to increase our efficiency</p> <p>&nbsp;</p> <p><strong>The Centre of Excellence</strong></p> <ul> <li>The Centre of Excellence is Fospha's early-careers programme that develops ambitious, high-performing talent through focused training, hands-on experience and cross-functional exposure. Starting in Customer Intelligence, you'll gain foundational experience while being prepared for future opportunities across the organisation. The programme operates on the following principles:</li> <li>Individual Responsibility from the Get-go: You will quickly be responsible for the success of your work, able to make an individual impact early in your career</li> <li>Work alongside SLT at Leading Businesses: You will be engaging with Senior Leadership and C-Level executives at the leading retail brands, getting exposure to how the top companies operate</li> <li>Become a Customer Facing Expert: You will be working directly with customers, often meeting them in person and developing your ability to create strong interpersonal relationships</li> <li>Cross-Functional Exposure: we offer unique opportunities to learn from and collaborate with every department in the business — many daily</li> <li>Comprehensive Training: In addition to the extensive on-the-job learning opportunities, you'll receive a broad and blended in-person training curriculum covering essential topics such as Business Storytelling, Account Management, Market Research &amp; Product and Financial Management</li> <li>Real Mentorship: Regular one-to-ones, feedback, and career conversations with people invested in your progression, not just your output</li> <li>Career Development: High performers have clear opportunities to quickly advance their careers at Fospha — whether progressing within our Customer Teams toward strategic and/or management roles or moving into other departments that align with your skills and interests</li> <li>Modern Tools: Hands-on exposure to Gen AI tooling through our Gen AI hub, so you're building modern, AI-fluent ways of working rather than legacy processes</li> </ul> <p>&nbsp;</p> <p><strong>What we can offer you</strong></p> <ul> <li>Salary: £34k + discretionary 10% bonus</li> <li>A workplace pension ~~through Royal London~~, with Fospha matching your contributions up to 3%</li> <li>A £1,000/year flexible benefits allowance to put towards private medical insurance, dental cover, a health cash plan, gym membership, extra holiday, or a pension top-up - whatever suits you!</li> <li>Access to Wellhub, giving you one membership across gyms, boutique studios, and wellbeing apps</li> <li>25 days' annual leave plus 8 UK bank holidays, an extra day off for your birthday! and more holiday the longer you stay (26 days after 3 years, 27 after 6)</li> <li>Life assurance worth 4x your annual salary, from day one</li> <li>Cycle to Work scheme, plus discounts on everyday spending through our benefits portal — Apple, Tesco, IKEA, M&amp;S, Deliveroo, cinema tickets and more</li> <li>Quarterly one-to-one sessions with a financial adviser, plus access to payroll-deducted loans through Salary Finance</li> <li>Paid volunteering days each year</li> <li>Regular socials, free weekly snacks, and Lunch &amp; Learn events at our Scale Space office, plus access to the wider Blenheim Chalcot community</li> <li>Opportunities to travel — including to our India and North America offices</li> </ul> <p>&nbsp;</p> <p><strong>What are we looking for?</strong></p> <ul> <li>We hire for potential – you don’t need a technical degree or marketing background. We’re looking for:</li> <li>Curious, proactive individuals who are keen to learn and grow</li> <li>Excellent verbal and written communication skills</li> <li>Strong relationship-building ability, both internally and externally</li> <li>Analytical mindset, comfortable interpreting data and creating insights – proficiency in Excel!</li> <li>Organised and able to manage multiple priorities simultaneously</li> <li>Solving problems for customers</li> <li>Interest in emerging technologies and excited by the potential and opportunity AI brings</li> </ul> <p>&nbsp;</p> <p><strong>Our Values and Principles</strong></p> <ul> <li>You will be able to demonstrate examples of our core principles:</li> <li>Seek inclusion &amp; diversity: We create an environment where everyone feels welcome, and people are encouraged to speak and be hear</li> <li>Work Hard, Work Well, Work Together: We take responsibility for making things happen, independently and together; we help colleagues in need and close loops, making sure our work is complete and has lasting impact</li> <li>Grow: We are proactive, curious and unafraid of failure</li> <li>Customer at the heart: We care about the customer, feel their pain and love building product that solves their biggest problems</li> <li>Candour with caring: We deliver candid feedback with kindness and receive it with gratitude</li> </ul> <p>&nbsp;</p><div class="content-conclusion"><p>By submitting your CV you understand that we have a legitimate interest to use your personal data for the purposes of assessing your eligibility for this role.&nbsp; title: Graduate - Babyzone
description: <p>Graduate Programme — Babyzone</p> <ul> <li><strong>Are you torn between the excitement of start-ups and the stability of corporate life?&nbsp;</strong></li> <li><strong>Are you keen to continue learning and developing skills whilst experiencing how to build businesses?</strong></li> <li><strong>Are you looking for a role that will offer the opportunity to experience first-hand how a tech company is built, and be supported while taking ownership of work that matters?&nbsp;</strong></li> </ul> <p>If this sounds like you and you are up for the challenge, we would love to hear from you!</p> <p>We are looking to hire high-energy, entrepreneurial and value-adding graduate talent to join Blenheim Chalcot in a role dedicated entirely to Babyzone, one of the social-impact organisations supported by BC.</p> <p><strong>ABOUT US</strong></p> <p>At Blenheim Chalcot, we invest more than just funds. We invest our knowledge and experience, our ideas and infrastructure. Our ventures are at the forefront of a multitude of industries being disrupted by digital including FinTech, EdTech, GovTech, Media, Sport, Charity and more. We are highly entrepreneurial and seek opportunities where digital technologies can disrupt major markets - ventures we have built include ClearScore, Salary Finance, Modulr and the Rajasthan Royals cricket team.</p> <p>Many of the companies within the portfolio have materialised from ideas conceived and launched by us, and we have over 4,000 employees to support their growth and development. Our assets under management stand at more than £1.8bn and total portfolio revenue is over £500 million.</p> <p>We work closely with investment and strategic partners ranging from Paypal, FIS, L&amp;G, Tencent, Experian, Google, WorldPay, Imperial College and some of the leading venture capital and private equity companies internationally.</p> <p>Our central team, Venture Builder Services (VBS), exists to support our ventures to be successful quickly, sustainably and with access to the best practice tools, solutions, and expertise. We provide a range of services to help new business get off the ground, including technology, growth (marketing and sales), talent, finance, legal and tax.</p> <p><strong>&nbsp;</strong></p> <p><strong>&nbsp;IMPACT BEYOND PROFIT</strong></p> <p>15% of our partnerships and ventures are charities. These include the British Asian Trust,&nbsp;Babyzone and Onside Youth Zones. In the same way that we support our ventures, our Partners provide direct hands-on support to these charities by being active board members and offering expert advice.</p> <p>ABOUT BABYZONE</p> <p>Babyzone is&nbsp;an innovative and fast-growing UK early childhood charity. It runs free, open-access community hubs for families with children aged 0-5 in areas of high deprivation, bringing together services, programmes and partners to improve outcomes for young children and their families.</p> <p>&nbsp;<strong>THE GRADUATE OPPORTUNITY</strong></p> <p>Joining Blenheim Chalcot as a Graduate, you will gain hands-on experience in a fast-paced and progressive environment while working exclusively with Babyzone. You will be embedded within the Babyzone team and contribute to meaningful projects that support the charity's growth, operations and impact, while benefiting from Blenheim Chalcot's learning, development and employee benefits.</p> <p>For you as a graduate, this opportunity involves:</p> <ul> <li>Dedicated to Babyzone – although you will be employed by Blenheim Chalcot, your role will sit fully within Babyzone. Your day-to-day work, projects and objectives will be focused entirely on supporting Babyzone and its mission, giving you the opportunity to build deep experience within a fast-growing, mission-led organisation.</li> <li>Training &amp; Development – we pride ourselves on having an intentional and continuous learning and development culture at Blenheim Chalcot. You will have access to BC learning and development opportunities designed to strengthen your core professional, commercial and leadership skills, while applying that learning directly to your work at Babyzone. You will learn by doing, taking on real responsibility and developing quickly within the Babyzone team.</li> <li>Early Careers Development – as a BC graduate, you will have access to structured development opportunities designed for those early in their careers. These will support your professional growth while your role itself remains fully dedicated to Babyzone.</li> <li>Graduate Community – you will be part of the wider BC graduate community, with access to relevant learning sessions, networking opportunities and socials. This community is intended to support your development and connection with fellow graduates; your substantive role and day-to-day responsibilities will remain entirely within Babyzone.</li> <li>Accountability – you will be given meaningful responsibility from the outset and supported to take ownership of work that matters. Rather than rotating between businesses, you will build continuity and depth within Babyzone, seeing the direct impact of your work on the organisation and the families and communities it serves.</li> </ul> <p><strong>&nbsp;</strong></p> <p><strong>ARE YOU BC?&nbsp;</strong></p> <p>We are not expecting you to have worked in start-ups before or to have studied a tech related degree. For us, it is about hiring the right person and their potential, not just their experience. As such, we are looking for graduates from any discipline – different areas of expertise are great for new perspectives.&nbsp;</p> <p>We look for some key fundamentals in people when hiring into the BC Group. We look for people who are:</p> <ul> <li><strong>Curious&nbsp;</strong>– people in BC are inquisitive, they want to understand ‘why’ and consider if there is a better approach rather than take on the ‘it’s how we’ve always done it’ perspective. Given our ethos is all about disrupting industries with new methods and products, curiosity is at the heart of what we do.</li> <li><strong>‘Doers’&nbsp;</strong>– surprisingly, this is not a given in a lot of working environments; we are a community of pro-active self-starters. We will provide full support to our graduates, though we do look for proactive people who can use their initiative and drive on a daily basis. Working in an environment where everyone has this trait is incredibly refreshing and we strive to maintain it.</li> <li><strong>Flexible Mindset –&nbsp;</strong>working in a growth business environment is ambiguous, diverse and, at times, chaotic by definition. Being adaptable and recognising the importance of flexibility to add value in a constantly evolving company is vital for us.</li> <li><strong>Enthusiasm –&nbsp;</strong>you do not need to be a ‘techy’ at heart to work in our environment. We are looking for people who are enthusiastic about what digitalisation is doing to industries and a drive to work in a pioneering sector which represents that drive. A desire for doing new and challenging things makes coming into work a whole lot more fun.</li> <li><strong>Humble &amp; Sociable&nbsp;</strong>– building a tech start-up is never easy. As such, we have a ‘no-ego’ policy and seek out people who bring energy to a team, not drain it. We have a down-to-earth and personable culture; we solve complex problems but do not take ourselves too seriously and look to have fun whilst doing so.</li> </ul> <p>If you see yourself in this and would like to work with similarly minded people, we would love to hear from you!</p> <p><strong>&nbsp;</strong></p> <p>WHAT WE CAN OFFER YOU AS A BC EMPLOYEE:</p> <ul> <li>Be part of the UK’s leading digital venture builder and have the opportunity to be a part of and learn from the incredible talent in BC</li> <li>Be exposed to the right mix of challenges and learning and development opportunities while building deep, hands-on experience within Babyzone</li> <li>A fun and open, if a little cricket obsessed, atmosphere</li> <li>Discretionary bonus</li> <li>25 days of paid holidays + your birthday off</li> <li>Life Assurance, Pension Scheme, Cycle to Work Scheme</li> <li>Flexible Benefits including Private Medical and Dental, Gym Subsidiaries</li> </ul> <p>&nbsp;</p> <p><strong>APPLICATION &amp; PROCESS</strong></p> <p>If you are keen to apply, please submit your CV and a member of our Talent Team will contact you with next steps. We have a rigorous recruitment process, which we use for all our roles to ensure we attract the very best talent.&nbsp;</p> <p>We have a three-stage process that will consist of the following:</p> <p>Stage 1: Telephone interview with a member of the BC Talent team</p> <p>&nbsp;</p> <p><strong>Stage 2:</strong>&nbsp;Virtual assessment day, consisting of both individual and group activities</p> <p>&nbsp;</p> <p>Stage 3: Final interviews with Blenheim Chalcot and Babyzone at Scale Space, White City</p> <p>&nbsp;</p> <p><strong>*Please note the timeframes provided above are subject to change, which we will communicate throughout the process*</strong></p> <p><em>Blenheim Chalcot is a proud Equal Opportunity Employer. Diversity is one of our core values, thus making it core to our business. We strive to maximise the diversity of our workforce and welcome applications from everyone. We encourage diversity through perspective, background, identity, and thought whilst also fostering an environment where everyone can express themselves regardless of your race, religion, sex, gender, colour, national origin, disability, or any other applicable legally protected characteristic. We are committed to continuing to nurture an inclusive environment and building a diverse workforce.</em></p><div class="content-conclusion"><p>By submitting your CV you understand that we have a legitimate interest to use your personal data for the purposes of assessing your eligibility for this role.&nbsp; This means that we may use your personal data to contact you to discuss your CV or arrange an interview, or transfer your CV to the hiring manager(s) of the role you have applied for.&nbsp; You can ask us at any time to remove your CV from our database by emailing&nbsp;<a ---------- but please note that this means we will no longer consider you for the role you have applied for.&nbsp;You can review our privacy policy<a href="https://www.blenheimchalcot.com/recruitment-privacy-policy/">&nbsp;here</a>.</p></div> Find Jobs in United Kingdom on Arbeitnow

title: People Director - Europe
description: <h2>About the Opportunity</h2> <p>We are looking for a People Director to help lead our Europe business through its next phase of growth. We need someone who can work alongside our European leadership team to shape the business, build leadership capability, retain exceptional talent, and ensure our People strategy evolves ahead of the business.&nbsp;</p> <p>The role will lead the People team across the UK and Portugal and play an important role in connecting Europe to Indicium AI’s global business strategy, People priorities and ways of working. You will represent the needs of the Europe business globally while helping translate our global objectives into regional priorities.&nbsp;</p> <p>Success in this role requires someone who is highly visible in the business, builds credibility and relationships quickly, brings the the confidence and judgment to influence senior leaders, and can introduce the right level of structure without creating unnecessary bureaucracy.&nbsp;</p> <p>You will lead and develop our existing Europe People team and work closely with our Global People and Talent team.&nbsp;</p> <p>This is a hybrid role with a minimum of three days per week in the office, plus regular travel to Lisbon.</p> <h2>Responsibilities</h2> <ul> <li>Lead the People strategy across the UK and Portugal, aligned with Europe and global business objectives.</li> <li>Help lead Europe through its next stage of scale, anticipating the organisational, leadership and talent capabilities needed as the business grows.</li> <li>Connect Europe to the global business, translating global priorities into regional People priorities while representing Europe’s needs in global decisions.</li> <li>Build strong, trusted relationships across the business, becoming a credible adviser to leaders on both business and People decisions.</li> <li>Strengthen leadership and management capability, coaching leaders through performance, organisational challenges, change and difficult people decisions.</li> <li>Build and retain exceptional talent, particularly across our technical and consulting teams, through career development, performance, compensation, succession and workforce planning.</li> <li>Support the continued growth of Portugal, ensuring we have the right organisation, leadership, talent practices and culture as the Lisbon team scales.</li> <li>Lead, mentor and develop the Europe People team, creating opportunities for the team to grow while maintaining ownership and autonomy.</li> <li>Build scalable People practices without over-engineering them, continuously improving core People processes, systems, reporting and ways of working as the organisation grows.</li> <li>Lead organisational change and manage People risk, including employee relations and other transformations, balancing employee experience with commercial realities.</li> </ul> <h2>Requirements</h2> <ul> <li>10+ years of progressive People/HR experience, with leadership responsibility and autonomy in a high-growth professional services organisation.</li> <li>Ability to work from our office at 100 Liverpool Street in London, UK and travel to Lisbon, Portugal regularly.&nbsp;</li> <li>Demonstrated experience helping an organisation navigate a meaningful stage of growth, including evolving its organisational structure, leadership capability and People model as the business scales.</li> <li>Strong experience partnering directly with senior executives and the credibility and judgment to influence business title: Senior Frontend Engineer
description: About MUBI MUBI is a global streaming service, production company and film distributor dedicated to elevating great cinema. To make this possible, we create, curate, acquire and champion visionary films, bringing them to audiences all over the world. We have a team of brilliant, dedicated and passionate people to help bring our mission to life. From London to New York, Istanbul to Paris, and Berlin to Mexico - we work together to realize MUBI’s vision. That’s where you come in! Join our global team and help us make great cinema accessible to everyone, everywhere. About the Role MUBI's web platform is where millions of people discover, read about and watch films. It's a streaming player, a curated catalogue and an editorial publication in one, and it has to feel fast and considered in every one of the countries we operate in. We are seeking a Senior Engineer to join our Frontend team. In this role, you will contribute to the architecture and implementation of MUBI’s website, serving millions of cinema enthusiasts across the globe. This is a hands-on, senior individual contributor role reporting to our Head of Frontend. You will partner closely with product managers, UX/UI designers, video CDN engineers, and backend teams to craft high-performance, seamless digital experiences - from our curated discovery channels to streaming platform capabilities and original editorial publications. We work hybrid-remote where we require 3 in-office days if you're near one of our sites. Our core days are Tuesday, Wednesday & Thursday, with the flexibility to use our offices on the remaining two days if you wish. Where you’ll have impact: Build the web experience. Design and implement features across the platform, from discovery and catalogue to the player and our editorial pages, in React, TypeScript and Next.js. You'll own them end to end: technical scoping, implementation, automated testing (unit, integration, E2E), deployment and observability. Make playback feel effortless. Work directly on media player integrations, adaptive streaming experiences, dynamic video previews, and high-framerate media components. Keep it fast. Analyze and continuously optimize client-side bundle size, Core Web Vitals, server-side rendering performance, and edge caching strategies. Raise the bar. Set the standard for code quality, testing and review on the team, and help other engineers get there. Use AI where it pays off. Experiment with coding agents, share the prompts and skills that work, and push for measurable gains over novelty. What you’ll bring: 8+ Years of Frontend Experience. Proven track record building and operating complex, consumer-facing web applications at scale using React, Next.js/SSR, and TypeScript. Expert knowledge of the DOM, browser rendering optimization, web performance profiling tools, state management strategies, and HTTP/media protocol fundamentals. Understanding of how the media is delivered to and played in modern web browsers. Familiarity with the features and problems of technologies like HLS, DASH, Widevine, FairPlay, CORS. Championing AI adoption across the team - experimenting with coding agents, sharing reusable prompts/skills, and pushing for measurable gains rather than novelty. Committed to maintainable code, test-driven development (Jest, React Testing Library, Cypress/Playwright), and strong CI/CD practices. Clear and articulate technical communication in an agile, cross-functional engineering organization. We use Slack & Linear. An independent mindset and genuine curiosity about how the product is used - you generate your own questions rather than waiting for a brief. Nice to have: Experience in a fast-paced, high-growth environment (e.g. startup or scale-up). Experience leading or contributing to cross-functional projects with teams such as Product, Marketing, Finance, or Engineering. Experience with design systems and close collaboration with designers. Genuine interest in film and in MUBI's mission. We want to make cinema accessible to everyone. We believe people from different backgrounds bring different ideas that foster innovation and engagement, allowing us to attract great people to develop the best experience for our users. MUBI is committed to being an Equal Opportunity Employer. That means it's our responsibility to ensure that all candidates are not discriminated against in our hiring processes and our employment decisions based on their race, color, religion, nationality or ethnic origin, age, gender identity or expression, sex, marital status, physical or mental disability, socioeconomic background, sexual orientation, family or parental status, or any other applicable characteristic. We are seeking a Senior Engineer to join our Frontend team. In this role, you will contribute to the architecture and implementation of MUBI’s website, serving millions of cinema enthusiasts across the globe. This is a hands-on, senior individual contributor role reporting to our Head of Frontend.

You will partner closely with product managers, UX/UI designers, video CDN engineers, and backend teams to craft high-performance, seamless digital experiences - from our curated discovery channels to streaming platform capabilities and original editorial publications.

We work hybrid-remote where we require 3 in-office days if you're near one of our sites. Our core days are Tuesday, Wednesday & Thursday, with the flexibility to use our offices on the remaining two days if you wish.

Where you’ll have impact:

  • Build the web experience. Design and implement features across the platform, from discovery and catalogue to the player and our editorial pages, in React, TypeScript and Next.js. You'll own them end to end: technical scoping, implementation, automated testing (unit, integration, E2E), deployment and observability.

  • Make playback feel effortless. Work directly on media player integrations, adaptive streaming experiences, dynamic video previews, and high-framerate media components.

  • Keep it fast. Analyze and continuously optimize client-side bundle size, Core Web Vitals, server-side rendering performance, and edge caching strategies.

  • Raise the bar. Set the standard for code quality, testing and review on the team, and help other engineers get there.

  • Use AI where it pays off. Experiment with coding agents, share the prompts and skills that work, and push for measurable gains over novelty.

What you’ll bring:

  • 8+ Years of Frontend Experience. Proven track record building and operating complex, consumer-facing web applications at scale using React, Next.js/SSR, and TypeScript.

  • Expert knowledge of the DOM, browser rendering optimization, web performance profiling tools, state management strategies, and HTTP/media protocol fundamentals.

  • Understanding of how the media is delivered to and played in modern web browsers. Familiarity with the features and problems of technologies like HLS, DASH, Widevine, FairPlay, CORS.

  • Championing AI adoption across the team - experimenting with coding agents, sharing reusable prompts/skills, and pushing for measurable gains rather than novelty.

  • Committed to maintainable code, test-driven development (Jest, React Testing Library, Cypress/Playwright), and strong CI/CD practices.

  • Clear and articulate technical communication in an agile, cross-functional engineering organization. We use Slack & Linear.

  • An independent mindset and genuine curiosity about how the product is used - you generate your own questions rather than waiting for a brief.

Nice to have:

  • Experience in a fast-paced, high-growth environment (e.g. startup or scale-up).

  • Experience leading or contributing to cross-functional projects with teams such as Product, Marketing, Finance, or Engineering.

  • Experience with design systems and close collaboration with designers.

  • Genuine interest in film and in MUBI's mission.

We want to make cinema accessible to everyone. We believe people from different backgrounds bring different ideas that foster innovation and engagement, allowing us to attract great people to develop the best experience for our users.

MUBI is committed to being an Equal Opportunity Employer. Why are we hiring for this role?

 

Due to continued growth, the Customer Success team is expanding and we require a Customer Success Manager to join our high-performing team to onboard and enable our customers. title: Senior Product Manager
description: Menlo Security is the leader in Browser Security for human and agentic workforces. Our mission is to enable humans and agents to connect, communicate, and collaborate securely, without compromise. The Menlo Browser Security Platform protects organizations from cyberattacks by stopping threats across the web, documents, and email before they reach the user. With Menlo Agent Runtime Security (MARS), that protection now extends to the AI agents working alongside every employee. Menlo Security is trusted by major global businesses, including Fortune 500 companies and government agencies, to protect their most valuable asset, their data, and is backed by top-tier investors. About the Role Summary Menlo Security is building MARS for Agents (Menlo Agent Runtime Security), our product line for securing autonomous and hybrid AI agents. This is a category still being defined — standards, architecture patterns, and competitive positioning are all forming in real time, with competitors ranging from established network security vendors to a wave of new agent-security startups. We are hiring an experienced Product Manager / Product Owner to take end-to-end ownership of a significant, technically complex area within MARS for Agents. The specific scope will be defined in partnership with the hiring manager based on team needs and the background of the person in this role, and will span identity and security concepts, relevant technical protocols, and platform integration and partnership work. The role operates with a high degree of autonomy day to day, working from strategic direction set by the Head of Product, in an environment that runs agile development at high velocity while actively building the process and rigor needed to scale a growing product line. This is also a team that works the way it builds: AI assistants and LLM-based tools are part of the daily toolkit here — used to synthesize customer and competitive signal, pressure-test requirements, and prototype against MCP clients and agent runtimes before a single line of production code is written. The person in this role will be defining security for a category they are already a fluent, curious user of. Outcomes & KPIs Key Outcome(s) Owned: End-to-end ownership of an assigned surface area of MARS for Agents — across capabilities such as the agent registry, Claude integration, Microsoft Copilot integration, MCP Server, MCP Proxy, and LLM proxy — from researched opportunity, to written requirement, to shipped and supported capability. A current, honest, decision-changing competitive point of view for the agent-security category that the wider go-to-market organization can rely on. Success Metrics / KPIs Roadmap delivery: committed roadmap items for the owned surfaces shipped within the target release window. Requirements quality: Reduction in mid-sprint requirement clarifications and rework attributable to ambiguous PRDs or acceptance criteria, measured via engineering feedback each quarter.   • Investigating first party claims by communicating with our policyholders by phone and email and conducting follow up investigations

  • Working proactively and efficiently to minimise leakage

  • Contacting customers regarding document requests or any necessary changes to their policy, and providing excellent customer service

  • Collaborating and building strong relationships with both the wider claims and fraud teams

  • Proactively identifying opportunities to improve our processes to help us to protect both the company loss ratio, and our honest customers

Who you are

  • You have an investigative mindset with strong attention to detail and accuracy

  • You are confident in good decision making, and can work efficiently under pressure

  • You have strong communication skills and are comfortable in liaising with other teams from across the business

  • You enjoy working in a high growth environment and are adaptable to change and balancing conflicting priorities

  • You are a self-starter who likes to take ownership

  • You take pride in delivering an excellent customer experience and enjoy interacting with our customers

  • You are tenacious and persistent; knowing when further investigation can lead to positive commercial outcomes for the business

What we're looking for from you

  • A background in fraud or claims/policy validation

  • Excellent verbal and written communication skills to be able to effectively communicate with our customers

  • You are really passionate about the customer, and will go the extra mile to offer them the best service

  • Working in a fast-paced scale up means that you have to be adaptable and excited by the prospect of moving fast

  • You enjoy finding solutions to problems you come across rather than waiting on others to do this for you

  • You enjoy taking ownership of your own workload, and proactively highlight any blockers that you or your team may be facing

description: About hyperexponential (hx) At hyperexponential, we're building the AI-powered platform that enables the world's most critical decisions in a $7 trillion industry, which risks to take, and how to price them. These are the decisions that shape real-world outcomes: whether rockets successfully launch into space, autonomous vehicles make it to market, or communities recover after major storms. Our platform brings together data, AI, and human expertise to give insurers the fastest path from submission to decision - helping them move faster, act smarter, and take on more risk with confidence. Backed by a16z, Highland Europe, and Battery Ventures, we're scaling globally - already trusted by nearly 50 of the world's largest insurers, with zero churn and billions in premiums flowing through hx. What began as a single product in one market has rapidly evolved into a multi-product, multi-territory platform powering every stage of pricing and underwriting. AI is at the core of what we do - from building the world's first domain-specific AI peer programmer for insurance (think GitHub Copilot with a PhD in actuarial science) to shaping agentic workflows that reinvent how this industry operates. What makes hx different is the people who build it. Here, impact isn't tied to title or tenure; it's defined by the challenges you take on and the discipline you bring. raw.title: Technical Trainer
raw.description:
About hyperexponential (hx)

At hyperexponential, we're building the AI-powered platform that enables the world's most critical decisions in a $7 trillion industry, which risks to take, and how to price them. These are the decisions that shape real-world outcomes: whether rockets successfully launch into space, autonomous vehicles make it to market, or communities recover after major storms.

Until now, insurance has been making billion-dollar decisions using outdated tools. We're changing that. Our platform brings together data, AI, and human expertise to give insurers the fastest path from submission to decision - helping them move faster, act smarter, and take on more risk with confidence.

Backed by a16z, Highland Europe, and Battery Ventures, we're scaling globally - already trusted by nearly 50 of the world's largest insurers, with zero churn and billions in premiums flowing through hx.

What began as a single product in one market has rapidly evolved into a multi-product, multi-territory platform powering every stage of pricing and underwriting. AI is at the core of what we do - from building the world's first domain-specific AI peer programmer for insurance (think GitHub Copilot with a PhD in actuarial science) to shaping agentic workflows that reinvent how this industry operates.

What makes hx different is the people who build it. Here, impact isn't tied to title or tenure; it's defined by the challenges you take on and the discipline you bring. Surrounded by peers who stretch you, you'll do the best, hardest work of your life in a company engineered to endure.

If that sounds like you, join us in building what comes next.

 

About the Client Education team

Every hx customer's success depends on their teams knowing how to use our platform well - not just how to click through it, but how to build genuinely good pricing models with it. Client Education exists to make that happen. We sit at the intersection of Product, Partnerships, and Customer teams, turning new features and platform capability into training, certification, and documentation that our clients and delivery partners can actually learn from.

The team owns the full learning journey: onboarding new clients, building certification pathways, producing courses and video content, and supporting partners who deliver training on our behalf. As hx's product surface has grown - Decision Engine, Pricing & Rating, Portfolio Intelligence, Submission Triage, and our AI agents - so has the volume and complexity of what we need to teach, and we're growing the team to keep pace.

We're looking for a Client Education Associate to join as a core part of this effort. Your focus will be delivering technical training directly to clients and partners, and supporting the team in building and maintaining the courses and certifications that make that training possible. You'll need enough technical grounding to be credible in front of a room of actuaries and developers, and enough teaching instinct to make complex material land.

 

What you'll be doing

  • Deliver technical training sessions, live and online, to clients and partners - covering everything from platform fundamentals to how to build pricing models using hx's AI agents and product tooling.

  • Build and maintain high-quality course content (online modules, video tutorials, workshop materials) that keeps pace with new product releases and evolving client needs.

  • Support the design and delivery of certification assessments, including practical exercises where candidates build real pricing tools in the hx platform.

  • Partner with Product, Customer, and Partnerships teams to translate new features into training material clients can actually use from day one.

  • Contribute to our partner enablement programme, helping external delivery partners onboard and deliver hx training to a consistent standard.

  • Help maintain and improve our course health and documentation processes, flagging content that's fallen out of date or out of line with current product naming and messaging.

 

What you'll need to have done

  • Delivered training, workshops, or technical explanations to a non-technical or semi-technical audience, and can point to material you've built or taught from.

  • Studied Computer Science or a related technical discipline, or built equivalent hands-on comfort with programming languages (Python or similar) through experience.

  • Worked hands-on with SaaS tools, APIs, or similar technical products, even without a formal software engineering background.

  • Taken the initiative to build or improve a course, process, or piece of learning content, rather than just following someone else's structure.

  • Communicated confidently and clearly with clients or external stakeholders, adjusting technical depth to fit the audience in front of you.

  • Worked well in an environment where scope shifts and you're expected to figure things out rather than wait for a fully defined brief.

 

You're unlikely to thrive here if

  • You'd rather follow a fixed curriculum than build and adapt training material as the product changes under you.

  • You're not comfortable being hands-on with technical concepts and tooling, even at a foundational level.

  • You prefer working in isolation rather than pulling in context from Product, Customer, and Partnerships teams to get training right.

If reading our Culture Document leaves you feeling neutral rather than energised, hx may not be the place where you'll do your best work. We're building something that asks for commitment and conviction, and we want you to feel excited by the opportunity to grow with us.

 

Compensation

At hx, we're committed to salary transparency. You'll always have clarity on pay early in the process - our Talent Partner will share details with you during initial conversations - and we're working towards publishing salary information for all roles globally.

Because we're building at the intersection of technology/SaaS and insurance, our roles don't always map neatly onto traditional benchmarks. Our approach is to design compensation that's competitive in the market, fair across teams, and aligned with the impact our people make.

Equity: We offer equity across all roles at hx, making it a significant component of total compensation. Your talent partner will be able to share more details about this.

 

Benefits

  • £5,000 training and conference budget for individual and group development.

  • 25 days of holiday plus 8 bank holidays (33 days total).

  • Company pension scheme via Penfold.

  • Mental health support and therapy via Spectrum.life.

  • Individual wellbeing allowance via Juno.

  • Private healthcare insurance through AXA.

  • Income protection and Life Insurance.

  • Cycle to Work Scheme

Additional perks

  • Top-spec equipment (laptop, screens, adjustable desks, etc.).

  • Regular remote and in-person hackathons, lunch and learns, socials, and game nights.

  • Team breakfasts and lunches, snacks, drinks fridge, and a fun office at The Ministry.

  • Exceptional opportunities for personal development and growth as we build something remarkable together.

 

Interview Process

  1. Initial call with our Talent team to kick things off (30 minutes)

  2. Manager interview with Dom (60 minutes)

  3. Practical training assessment: build and present a short curriculum plan for a real hx feature, followed by discussion (60-90 minutes)

  4. Values interview (60 minutes)

  5. Meet the CEO

  6. We offer!

 

Our commitment to Diversity

hxer's are at the centre of everything we build. We know that progress depends on diverse perspectives, and we are committed to creating an environment where everyone can thrive, grow, and make an impact. We recognise there is always more to do, and we take responsibility for shaping a workplace that is not only diverse but genuinely inclusive.

Diversity is not just the right thing to do, it is key to solving the complex challenges we choose to take on. By welcoming people from all backgrounds and experiences, we strengthen our ability to question assumptions, push boundaries, and design solutions that endure.

If you're energised by complexity and motivated to grow, we encourage you to apply and join our global team.

 

Next steps

If this opportunity resonates with you, we encourage you to apply or share it with your connections! Our dedicated talent team reviews all applications, and we promise to provide feedback regardless of the outcome.

For more information about applying and to view other opportunities, you can visit our careers page.

Please note that background checks will be conducted as part of the hiring process to ensure compliance with our governance policies. We handle all background checks sensitively and in full compliance with relevant regulations. All applicant data will be processed in accordance with data protection regulations and our privacy policy.

You speak the language of ARR, NRR, churn, and product-led growth.<br><br></li> <li>You possess highly consultative stakeholder management skills. Every donation will be matched by Dashlane</li> <li>Team buildings &amp; seasonal social events</li> <li>Weekly lunch in the office and monthly happy hour</li> <li>and many more!</li> </ul><div class="content-conclusion"><p><strong>Diversity, Equity, Inclusion and Belonging at Dashlane:</strong></p> <p>As a truly international company—founded in France and <span style="color: #172b4d;">distributed across</span> France, US and Portugal—Dashlane thrives off diverse perspectives. description: Who We Are Inato is a Tech for Good company striving to bring clinical research to each and every patient, regardless of who they are or where they live. To do this, we are building the world's first clinical trial platform to create greater visibility, access, and engagement across a more diverse population of doctors and their patients. Drug development is a challenging, intellectually complex, and rewarding endeavor: we enable global pharmaceutical companies to confidently partner with community-based researchers to increase patient access to the latest medical innovations. We are a growing team of passionate pharmaceutical experts, software and AI engineers, professional services members, and many more—all bringing their unique perspectives to solve the challenges facing clinical research. Inato is the recent recipient of Fast Company’s Most Innovative Companies of 2024, Fierce Healthcare’s Fierce 15, and Built In's Best Places to Work 2025. 🧑‍💻 The Role We are looking for a dedicated and creative AI Engineer to join our team. As an essential contributor to our mission of transforming healthcare, you'll play a leading role in building AI-driven solutions that directly influence clinical research and, ultimately, improve patient care. We’ve already deployed multiple AI use cases in production, and your skills will be crucial in pushing the boundaries of healthcare AI. 💊 Responsibilities In this role, you'll take on complex challenges that will stretch your abilities and creativity: Choose and orchestrate the right models to process and analyze multimodal data Design and implement cutting-edge RAG techniques to efficiently handle large medical documents and patient histories Build agentic systems to revolutionize key aspects of drug development such as patient recruitment or site selection Work closely with cross-functional teams (software engineers, product managers, data engineers) to seamlessly integrate AI into our platform Implement robust and scalable pipelines that meet production-grade engineering standards Here are some examples of projects you might work on: Our prescreening tool: an app relying on the latest reasoning models and visual RAG to accelerate patient recruitment. It's already being used across hundreds of clinical sites to assess patient eligibility at scale. You may find more on this in our publication: https://arxiv.org/abs/2503.15374 Our site selection agent : an agentic assistant coupled with a mathematical optimizer to assist pharmaceutical sponsors in their search for efficient clinical sites and find the right mix of sites for every study 💊 Qualifications Hands-on professional experience on LLMs (OpenAI, Anthropic, RAG setup, agent setup, LLM observability tools etc.), 1 year in a production environment (not a pet project) Python proficiency Strong problem-solving skills Strong communication skills, oral and written, both English and French Strong product mindset able to challenge the product roadmap directly with our CPO Experience implementing and deploying AI-based features in production Knowledge about LLM’s evaluation challenges Ability to autonomously deliver clean and production-ready code Bonus you reconverted from software engineering Why Inato? raw.title: Senior Product Designer
raw.description:
Updated in September 2026

About Upflow

 

Upflow is the Financial Relationship Management (FRM) platform that helps B2B finance teams collect smarter and get paid by their customers faster, with AI agents working alongside the team.

Today, the order-to-cash process is mission critical for businesses, yet it remains fragmented across tools, teams, and workflows. Upflow brings this entire process into one system — four products covering the cycle from invoice to cash (Insights, Collections, Payments, and Cash Application), with AI agents that work alongside the team and a shared intelligence layer underneath.

We serve 500+ companies across 30+ countries, including Vercel, Lattice, and Productboard, and are backed by leading investors including Y Combinator, Hedosophia, Hexa, and Lorimer. With teams across the US and Europe, we're building a category-defining company at the intersection of finance, payments, and AI.

To learn more about what we do, visit upflow.io. For a behind-the-scenes look at how we work as a team, head to the Inside Upflow section of our blog at upflow.io/blog/inside-upflow.

Your role at Upflow

 

As a Senior Product Designer, you'll define solutions that allow finance teams to experience consumer grade UX in their day to day lives.

  • Lead end-to-end design projects, work closely with engineers, product managers and other stakeholders to ensure a high-quality implementation

  • Create flows, prototypes, and high-fidelity visuals (we use Figma, Cursor and Claude)

  • Plan and run user research and usability tests

  • Own our design system to ensure efficient delivery of new features

  • Contribute to overall strategy and decision-making about product direction

  • Collaborate with Marketing on our brand design, ensuring our app and communications feel coherent

Who you are

  • 5+ years of experience in Product Design

  • Curiosity for people’s problems, and a drive to figure out best-in-class solutions for them

  • Track record of shipping high‑impact product work in B2B or complex workflows

  • You have embraced AI capabilities to craft your designs

  • A portfolio that clearly explains context, constraints, your decisions, and impact

  • You adhere to our operating principles

Why join us

Here what you’ll find at Upflow:

  • International Mindset: We have offices in Paris and New York.

  • Exciting moment: Opportunity to join early and contribute to the Design function from the ground up.

  • All-star team: Extremely solid team with deep functional and domain expertise.

  • Learning opportunity: Strong focus on learning and growing through education and professional development in hard and soft skills.

  • Trusting environment: Hands-off management style. We have a strong culture of ownership and autonomy.

  • Best in class perks: 35 paid days off, meal vouchers, cool offices, top-of-the-range equipment, great healthcare, and competitive salary and equity.

  • Offsites: Regular offsites with the team, meetups, and strong connections to the startup ecosystem

Recruitment process

1 - Screening call with JM, Product Director

It’s a discussion with your future manager. We’ll get deeper into your expertise and know-how. We’ll also give you a clearer view of what your day-to-day in that role is like. It’s a good opportunity to see if you foresee yourself working at Upflow.

 

2 - Home assignment

Your time to shine! You’ll be given a home assignment. Yes, it is designed to assess your skills. But it’s also designed to give you a better taste of what being part of Upflow is like. Again, hiring is a two-way street! Ultimately: we believe assignments are a great way to control our biases. We care for what you do; not your schooling, social background, or the gender you identify yourself to.

 

3 - Home assignment review

Your hiring manager will spend up to 60 minutes debriefing your case with you. A peer can take part in this review. Hiring managers at Upflow are looking for team players: taking and giving feedback is key to thriving with us!

 

4 - Meet the team

You'll meet with members of the team so you can foresee yourself as part of it 😃

 

5 - Founder interview

Meet with Alex (co-founder & CEO). He will tell you everything about Upflow’s vision and values. It’s a privileged moment to ask questions, too.

6 - Reference check

 

7 - Alignment & offer

If you’ve made it this far, chances are we like each other and it feels like Upflow is a place you can grow and shine over the next few years. We will align on the right way for you to come on board, and if successful in that process we will extend you an offer, and you can relax and get ready for your new job.

 

*****

 

Diversity & Inclusion

At Upflow, we are committed to building a diverse and inclusive workplace. We encourage all individuals to apply, even if you don’t meet every qualification. Research shows that some candidates may hesitate to apply unless they meet every requirement. However, we believe that a variety of experiences and perspectives can bring value beyond the listed qualifications. If you’re excited about what we do and feel you could contribute, we want to hear from you.

description: About the company The transition to a sustainable future requires discovering new mineral resources to power clean technologies and renewable energy solutions. From lithium for electric vehicle batteries, to copper for wind turbines, and rare earth elements for electronics, these minerals are the building blocks of our energy transition. Lithosquare radically speeds up mineral exploration by combining foundational AI, geological expertise, and real-world data to reduce uncertainty, prioritize the right targets, reduce costs and accelerate discovery. Based in Paris, Lithosquare gathered an exceptional team of geologists, scientists, AI engineers, and data specialists to work as one, from field sampling to model optimization and push the boundaries of what's possible. About the job As a Geologist at Lithosquare, you will play a key hybrid role at the intersection of field operation (around 20%) and office work (80%). You will support field campaign execution while actively contributing to data compilation, targeting, and QA/QC across our exploration portfolio. This is a dynamic, cross-functional role: you will divide your time between field work (reconnaissance, sampling, drilling support) and office work in Paris, working closely with senior geologists, data scientists, and AI engineers. We are looking for someone rigorous, curious about technological innovation, and eager to learn while helping build the next generation of AI-assisted exploration tools. What you'll do Reporting to the Senior Geologists and the VP Asset Development, your main responsibilities will include: Field Execution & Support: Support and participate in all phases of field exploration programs, including regional reconnaissance, surface sampling, geophysical surveys, and drilling campaigns. What we are looking for Minimum 3 years of experience in mineral exploration geology Degree in Geology or Earth Sciences , with solid foundations in metallogeny, structural geology, or geochemistry First significant field exposure (mapping, sampling, or core logging) with a willingness to spend significant time in the field as required by projects Data-driven & Rigorous: A structured approach to data management, QA/QC, and documentation; familiarity with GIS software (QGIS, ArcGIS) and/or geological modeling software is a plus Tech-curious & Innovative mindset: Genuine interest in how AI and technology can transform traditional exploration methods Strong Communication: Ability to collaborate effectively in a multi-disciplinary team (geologists, data scientists, AI engineers), interact professionally with partners and produce clear, synthetic & high-quality deliverables Mission-driven: Passionate about the energy transition and solving complex physical-world challenges through innovation Fluency in English is required with previous exposure to international exchanges Valid Driver's License (Permis B) is a bonus Perks & Benefits 🏢 Offices located in the heart of Paris 🌱 Strong culture of ownership & entrepreneurship 🌍 Opportunity to significantly contribute to energy transition 👥 Collaborative work environment with world-class experts in geology, AI, and data science 🔄 Flexible work arrangements enabling work-life balance 🚴 Sustainable mobility allowance ( Forfait Mobilité Durable ) 🏋️ Gym pass 🎉 Frequent team drinks, events & regular off-sites 💰 Competitive salary package 🍽️ Meal vouchers and health insurance coverage (Alan) Join Lithosquare and become part of a passionate team driving innovation at the intersection of AI and Earth exploration. raw.description:
About Prelude

Prelude is redefining how companies authenticate and onboard users - turning what's traditionally a cost center into a growth lever.

Our flagship product lets businesses send OTP codes with the best price-to-conversion ratio on the market, dynamically selecting the most effective channel in real time (optimized SMS, WhatsApp, and more) while actively blocking spam and fraud that legacy providers miss.

Founded in 2022 by former Zenly team members who lived the pain of broken SMS authentication firsthand, we're already serving fast-growing companies across Europe and are expanding into the US.

But authentication is only the starting point - we're building the platform for trust at scale, with an ambitious roadmap of market-defining products ahead.

Why join us

Today, we're a team of 60 and growing, based in Paris, building products that power secure and high-performance user onboarding for companies across the world. We believe small, highly skilled teams outperform large, fragmented organizations, and we are intentional about staying focused on impact, quality, and speed.

We operate with a flat org structure and value in-person collaboration, which helps ideas move faster, decisions stay grounded, and teams take full ownership of what they build.
Our values

  • Care
    We care deeply about our customers, our teammates, and the quality and reliability of what we ship.

  • Bias for Action
    We move fast, test in the real world, and iterate quickly rather than over-optimizing in theory.

  • Ownership
    We take responsibility end to end, from identifying problems to delivering outcomes and learning from results.


About the role

Internal tooling is not a backlog item at Prelude — it's a strategic lever. As we scale from 50 to a much larger team, the speed at which engineering, ops, sales, support, and finance can operate depends on the tools we put in their hands.

You'll own that surface. You'll build the internal tools and AI-powered automation that make every team at Prelude move faster, ship with confidence, and spend their time on the work that actually matters. You'll work directly with internal stakeholders to find friction and turn it into functional, reliable software — and you'll be our edge in AI engineering, evaluating and integrating the tools that define how a modern company operates. Here are some examples of projects :

  • Interconnect the various internal tools we use (hubspot, linear, plain and more)

  • Optimize the way we calculate and aggregate our billing

  • Build flows and use AI to automate our internal processes (invoicing/reporting/support)

This is a high-ownership IC role on the Platform team, with direct access to your internal customers from day one.

What will you be doing?

  • Owning the design, development, and maintenance of internal tools used daily across engineering, ops, product, sales, support, and finance

  • Building agentic AI workflows that automate repetitive internal processes and unlock new capabilities for our teams (fraud review, customer support triage, GTM workflows, ops dashboards, and more)

  • Working directly with stakeholders across all teams to identify friction and turn it into functional solutions, with feedback loops measured in days, not quarters

  • Evaluating and integrating the latest AI engineering tools (Claude, Cursor, n8n, Dust, and whatever comes next) and setting the standard for how Prelude leverages them internally

  • Contributing to our polyglot codebase and collaborating with the broader engineering team on shared infrastructure, schemas, and APIs

  • Designing and building internal dashboards on top of our data layer (DynamoDB, Clickhouse and Postgres) to give every team visibility into what they need to act on

  • Participating in on-call rotations for the internal platform you build

What are we looking for?

  • Software engineer with experience shipping in high-paced environments and a track record of finishing what you start

  • You've shipped automated workflows and AI-powered tools in production (n8n, Dust, custom LLM pipelines, or equivalent), not just prototyped with them

  • You've built for internal users before and understand that reliability matters more than polish — but that good UX still earns you adoption

  • Solid backend skills in Go or TypeScript, with the ability to design and build reliable APIs and services

  • Comfortable working across the stack — React on the frontend when the tool needs a UI, plus the data layer (DynamoDB, SQS, Lambdas) underneath

  • A preference for simplicity vs complexity, with intuition for what will scale effectively as the company grows

  • A product-led mindset — you code for outcomes and impact, and you can talk to a non-engineer stakeholder without translating from engineer-speak

  • Fluent/professional English given our international team

Nice to have

  • Experience with developer experience or platform engineering

  • Familiarity with fintech, identity, fraud, or another regulated/high-stakes domain

  • Experience integrating with common SaaS APIs (CRM, billing, support, data warehouse)

  • Any experience with Rust, gRPC, or AWS serverless (Lambda, DynamoDB, SQS) is a plus

Tech stack

  • Primary: Go, TypeScript, React

  • Codebase and data: Go services, Next.js, gRPC, DynamoDB, SQS, Redshift, Lambdas

  • AI tooling: LLMs (Claude and others), agent frameworks, Cursor, n8n, Dust, and whatever comes next

What can we offer you?

  • Competitive compensation package with BSPCEs

  • 3 days in-office in central Paris, with 2 days WFH; and 4 weeks of remote work per year

  • 100% travel to the office subsidised

  • Health insurance via Alan

  • Urban Sports Club gym membership

  • We will provide you with the gear you need for your role (a laptop and a phone, for on-call rotations)

  • Swile meal vouchers

  • Free snacks and drinks in the office

  • An annual offsite in a great location (last one was at La Pradet!)

  • The opportunity to build something from 0-1, and make an impact every day

Interview process

  • Meet a member of the Talent team

  • Technical assessment

  • In-person interview (system design, coding)

  • Final meeting with CEO

We don't expect you to ace all these stages, we will evaluate your creativity and how you approach difficult problems. You should consider applying even if you don't meet all the criteria.
